## Key Implementation Details

### lxc-sidecars Module Structure

```
tofu/modules/lxc-sidecars/
├── main.tf              # Backup + future sidecar logic
├── variables.tf         # backup, diun_enabled, promtail_enabled
├── outputs.tf          # Backup status, timer info
├── versions.tf         # Provider requirements
├── README.md           # Module documentation
└── templates/
    ├── configure-backup-playbook.yml.tftpl
    ├── pbs-backup.sh.tftpl
    ├── diun-compose.yml.tftpl         # Future
    └── promtail-compose.yml.tftpl     # Future
```

**Future additions** (all as simple docker containers in main.tf):
- `diun_enabled = true` → Deploy DIUN docker-compose
- `promtail_enabled = true` → Deploy Promtail docker-compose
- `cadvisor_enabled = true` → Deploy cAdvisor docker-compose

### Backup Variable Structure

```hcl
# tofu/modules/lxc-sidecars/variables.tf

variable "container_id" {
  description = "LXC container ID"
  type        = number
}

variable "container_ip" {
  description = "Container IP address"
  type        = string
}

variable "container_name" {
  description = "Container hostname"
  type        = string
}

variable "proxmox_ssh_host" {
  description = "Proxmox host SSH address"
  type        = string
}

variable "proxmox_ssh_private_key_path" {
  description = "SSH private key path"
  type        = string
}

variable "backup" {
  type = object({
    enabled     = bool
    schedule    = string                    # "daily", "02:00", "Sun 03:00"
    retention   = optional(string, "7")
    namespace   = string

    pre_backup_commands = optional(list(object({
      name    = string
      command = string
      timeout = optional(number, 300)
    })), [])

    include_paths = optional(list(string), ["/config"])
    exclude_paths = optional(list(string), ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"])

    ntfy_url      = optional(string, "http://10.100.5.100:8080/homelab-alerts")
    ntfy_priority = optional(string, "default")
    ntfy_tags     = optional(string, "backup")
  })
  default = null
}
```

### Backup Script Features
- Pre-backup hooks execution (database dumps)
- Structured logging to `/var/log/pbs-backups/<namespace>.log`
- Error handling with ntfy alerts on failure
- Automatic pruning after successful backup
- Cleanup of temporary dump files

### PBS Server Configuration
- User: `backup@pbs` (password from 1Password)
- ACL: DatastoreBackup on datastore "homelab"
- Prune: Daily, keep 7 daily + 4 weekly
- GC: Weekly on Sunday at 2 AM
- Namespaces: Auto-created per container

## Testing & Validation

### Verify Backup Success
```bash
# Check systemd timer
ssh root@<container-ip> "systemctl status pbs-backup-<id>.timer"

# Check logs
ssh root@<container-ip> "tail -50 /var/log/pbs-backups/<namespace>.log"

# Verify in PBS web UI
open https://10.100.1.102:8007
```

### Test Restore
```bash
# List backups
ssh root@homelab "pct exec 102 -- proxmox-backup-client list \
  --repository backup@pbs@10.100.1.102:homelab --ns <namespace>"

# Restore to test location
ssh root@<container> "proxmox-backup-client restore \
  --repository backup@pbs@10.100.1.102:homelab \
  --ns <namespace> lxc-<id>/<snapshot> /tmp/restore-test"
```

### Test Alerts
```bash
# Break backup script temporarily
ssh root@<container> "vi /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup/backup-<id>.sh"
# Add: exit 1 before run_backup

# Trigger manually
systemctl start pbs-backup-<id>.service

# Verify ntfy alert received
curl http://10.100.5.100:8080/homelab-alerts/json
```

## Rollback Plan

If issues occur:

1. **Re-enable vzdump:**
   ```bash
   ssh root@homelab "cp /etc/pve/jobs.cfg.backup-vzdump /etc/pve/jobs.cfg"
   ```

2. **Disable PBS timers:**
   ```bash
   ssh root@homelab "pct exec <id> -- systemctl disable --now pbs-backup-<id>.timer"
   ```

3. **Revert app configuration:**
   ```hcl
   backup = {
     enabled = false  # Disable in main.tf
   }
   ```

## Next Steps

1. ✅ Review and approve this plan
2. Create `pbs-setup-server.yml` playbook
3. Enhance `lxc-base` module with backup support
4. Add backup config to obsidian-sync (test)
5. Migrate daily containers
6. Migrate weekly containers
7. Cleanup and documentation

## Timeline Estimate

### Implementation Phase (Days 1-5)
- **Day 1:** PBS setup + lxc-sidecars module creation (4-6 hours)
- **Day 2:** Test container + daily containers migration (3-4 hours)
- **Day 3:** Weekly containers migration (2-3 hours)
- **Days 4-5:** Testing, verification (1-2 hours)

### Validation Phase (Days 6-13)
- **Days 6-12:** Both systems running, monitoring (15 min/day)
- **Day 13:** Full restore test (2-3 hours)

### Cleanup Phase (Day 14+)
- **Day 14:** Disable vzdump, archive, documentation (2 hours)

**Total Implementation:** 10-15 hours
**Total Including Validation:** 13-20 hours spread over 14 days

## Dependencies

- PBS container (102) running and accessible
- 1Password entry for PBS backup user password
- OpenTofu modules (lxc-base, docker-lxc) accessible
- Ansible inventory with all containers
- SSH access to all containers and Proxmox host

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure Proxmox Backup Jobs for PBS
# =============================================================================
# Sets up scheduled backup jobs in Proxmox VE to use PBS storage.
# Replaces manual editing of /etc/pve/jobs.cfg
#
# Usage:
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml --tags verify
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure PBS backup jobs
  hosts: proxmox
  gather_facts: false

  vars:
    pbs_storage: pbs-homelab
    pbs_datastore: homelab

    # Daily backups - User data services (2 AM, keep 7 days)
    daily_containers:
      - 304  # immich
      - 303  # immich-importer
      - 501  # openwebui
      - 502  # n8n
      - 503  # obsidian-sync
      - 504  # documents

    # Weekly backups - Infrastructure services (Sunday 3 AM, keep 4 weeks)
    weekly_containers:
      - 100  # portainer
      - 101  # network-services
      - 200  # traefik
      - 201  # dashboards-app
      - 202  # authelia
      - 401  # jellyfin
      - 402  # media-management
      - 500  # monitoring-app

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Verify PBS Storage
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check PBS storage status
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: pvesm status | grep {{ pbs_storage }}
      register: pbs_status
      changed_when: false
      tags: [always]

    - name: Verify PBS is active
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: |
          PBS storage '{{ pbs_storage }}' is not active.
          Status: {{ pbs_status.stdout }}
          Fix by updating PBS password:
            pvesm set {{ pbs_storage }} --password 'YOUR_PASSWORD'
      when: "'active' not in pbs_status.stdout"
      tags: [always]

    # =========================================================================
    # Backup Pre-Backup Hook Script
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if pre-backup hook exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
      register: hook_script
      tags: [always]

    - name: Display hook script status
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Pre-backup hook: {{ 'EXISTS' if hook_script.stat.exists else 'MISSING' }}"
      tags: [verify]

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure Backup Jobs
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create backup jobs configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/pve/jobs.cfg
        content: |
          # Proxmox Backup Jobs Configuration
          # Managed by Ansible: ansible/playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml
          # DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - Changes will be overwritten
          #
          # Backup Strategy:
          #   - Daily: User data that changes frequently (immich, openwebui, n8n, etc.)
          #   - Weekly: Infrastructure/config that rarely changes (traefik, portainer, etc.)
          #
          # Storage: {{ pbs_storage }} (Proxmox Backup Server)
          # Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}

          # =============================================================================
          # Daily Backups - User data services (2 AM, keep 7 days)
          # =============================================================================
          # 304 = immich (photos database)
          # 303 = immich-importer (import tools)
          # 501 = openwebui (chat history, settings)
          # 502 = n8n (workflow automations)
          # 503 = obsidian-sync (notes sync server)
          # 504 = documents (paperless, stirling-pdf)
          vzdump: daily-user-data
          	enabled 1
          	schedule 02:00
          	storage {{ pbs_storage }}
          	mailnotification failure
          	mode snapshot
          	compress zstd
          	vmid {{ daily_containers | join(',') }}
          	{% if hook_script.stat.exists %}script /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
          	{% endif %}prune-backups keep-daily=7

          # =============================================================================
          # Weekly Backups - Infrastructure services (Sunday 3 AM, keep 4 weeks)
          # =============================================================================
          # 100 = portainer
          # 101 = network-services (adguard)
          # 200 = traefik
          # 201 = dashboards-app
          # 202 = authelia
          # 401 = jellyfin
          # 402 = media-management
          # 500 = monitoring-app
          vzdump: weekly-infrastructure
          	enabled 1
          	schedule sun 03:00
          	storage {{ pbs_storage }}
          	mailnotification failure
          	mode snapshot
          	compress zstd
          	vmid {{ weekly_containers | join(',') }}
          	{% if hook_script.stat.exists %}script /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
          	{% endif %}prune-backups keep-weekly=4
        mode: '0640'
      register: jobs_config
      tags: [configure]

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: List configured backup jobs
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: pvesh get /cluster/backup --output-format=json-pretty
      register: backup_jobs
      changed_when: false
      tags: [verify, configure]

    - name: Display backup jobs
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ backup_jobs.stdout | from_json }}"
      tags: [verify, configure]

    - name: Count daily backup containers
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        daily_count: "{{ daily_containers | length }}"
        weekly_count: "{{ weekly_containers | length }}"
      tags: [verify, configure]

    - name: Display backup summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Backup Jobs Configured ==="
          - ""
          - "Storage: {{ pbs_storage }}"
          - "Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}"
          - ""
          - "Daily Backups ({{ daily_count }} containers):"
          - "  Schedule: Daily at 2:00 AM"
          - "  Retention: 7 days"
          - "  Containers: {{ daily_containers | join(', ') }}"
          - ""
          - "Weekly Backups ({{ weekly_count }} containers):"
          - "  Schedule: Sunday at 3:00 AM"
          - "  Retention: 4 weeks"
          - "  Containers: {{ weekly_containers | join(', ') }}"
          - ""
          - "Excluded from backups:"
          - "  102 = proxmox-backup-server (PBS itself)"
          - "  600 = desktop-tmp (temporary desktop)"
          - ""
          - "Next steps:"
          - "  1. Verify in Proxmox UI: Datacenter > Backup"
          - "  2. Test backup: Run backup job manually"
          - "  3. Monitor PBS: https://10.100.1.102:8007"
      tags: [verify, configure]

    # =========================================================================
    # Manual Trigger (Optional)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Trigger daily backup now (manual)
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: pvesh create /cluster/backup-info/not-backed-up --output-format=json
      register: trigger_result
      when: trigger_now is defined and trigger_now | bool
      tags: [never, trigger]

    - name: Display trigger result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ trigger_result.stdout | from_json }}"
      when: trigger_now is defined and trigger_now | bool
      tags: [never, trigger]

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure Proxmox Backup Server (PBS)
# =============================================================================
# One-time setup for PBS server configuration.
# Creates backup@pbs user, configures ACLs, sets up prune/GC schedules.
#
# Prerequisites:
#   - PBS container (102) running and accessible
#   - PBS root password set
#   - Password stored in 1Password: op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password
#
# Usage:
#   export PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD=$(op read 'op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password')
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="$PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD"
#
# What this playbook does:
#   1. Creates backup@pbs user with DatastoreBackup permissions
#   2. Configures datastore "homelab" (if not exists)
#   3. Sets up prune schedule (7 daily + 4 weekly)
#   4. Configures garbage collection (Sunday 2 AM)
#   5. Verifies configuration
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure Proxmox Backup Server
  hosts: pbs
  gather_facts: false

  vars:
    pbs_datastore: homelab
    pbs_datastore_path: /tank/backups/pbs
    pbs_backup_user: backup@pbs

    # Prune settings
    prune_keep_daily: 7
    prune_keep_weekly: 4

    # GC schedule (Sunday 2 AM)
    gc_schedule: "sun 02:00"

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Verify PBS backup password is provided
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: |
          PBS backup password not provided!
          Usage: ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="PASSWORD"
          Get password: op read 'op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password'
      when: pbs_backup_password is not defined or pbs_backup_password == ""

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Verify PBS is accessible
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check PBS API accessibility
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: https://{{ ansible_host }}:8007/api2/json/version
        validate_certs: false
        method: GET
      register: pbs_version
      failed_when: false
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display PBS version
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "PBS Version: {{ pbs_version.json.data.version }}"
      when: pbs_version.status == 200

    - name: Fail if PBS is not accessible
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: "PBS API not accessible at https://{{ ansible_host }}:8007"
      when: pbs_version.status != 200

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Datastore (if not exists)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if datastore exists
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager datastore list --output-format json
      register: datastore_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse datastore list
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        existing_datastores: "{{ datastore_list.stdout | from_json | map(attribute='name') | list }}"

    - name: Create datastore if not exists
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager datastore create {{ pbs_datastore }}
          --path {{ pbs_datastore_path }}
          --gc-schedule '{{ gc_schedule }}'
          --keep-daily {{ prune_keep_daily }}
          --keep-weekly {{ prune_keep_weekly }}
      when: pbs_datastore not in existing_datastores
      register: datastore_created

    - name: Display datastore creation result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Datastore '{{ pbs_datastore }}' created at {{ pbs_datastore_path }}"
      when: datastore_created is changed

    - name: Update existing datastore settings
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager datastore update {{ pbs_datastore }}
          --gc-schedule '{{ gc_schedule }}'
          --keep-daily {{ prune_keep_daily }}
          --keep-weekly {{ prune_keep_weekly }}
      when: pbs_datastore in existing_datastores
      register: datastore_updated
      changed_when: datastore_updated.rc == 0

    # =========================================================================
    # Create backup@pbs User
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if backup@pbs user exists
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager user list --output-format json
      register: user_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse user list
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        existing_users: "{{ user_list.stdout | from_json | map(attribute='userid') | list }}"

    - name: Create backup@pbs user
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager user create {{ pbs_backup_user }}
          --password '{{ pbs_backup_password }}'
      when: pbs_backup_user not in existing_users
      register: user_created
      no_log: true

    - name: Update backup@pbs user password
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager user update {{ pbs_backup_user }}
          --password '{{ pbs_backup_password }}'
      when: pbs_backup_user in existing_users
      register: user_updated
      changed_when: user_updated.rc == 0
      no_log: true

    - name: Display user creation result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "User '{{ pbs_backup_user }}' {{ 'created' if user_created is changed else 'updated' }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure ACLs for backup@pbs user
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check existing ACLs
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager acl list --output-format json
      register: acl_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse ACL list
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        existing_acls: "{{ acl_list.stdout | from_json }}"

    - name: Check if DatastoreBackup ACL exists for user
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        acl_exists: "{{ existing_acls | selectattr('ugid', 'equalto', pbs_backup_user) | selectattr('path', 'equalto', '/datastore/' + pbs_datastore) | list | length > 0 }}"

    - name: Grant DatastoreBackup permission to backup@pbs
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager acl update /datastore/{{ pbs_datastore }}
          --auth-id {{ pbs_backup_user }}
          --role DatastoreBackup
      when: not acl_exists
      register: acl_created

    - name: Display ACL creation result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "ACL granted: {{ pbs_backup_user }} → DatastoreBackup on /datastore/{{ pbs_datastore }}"
      when: acl_created is changed

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Get final datastore configuration
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager datastore list --output-format json
      register: final_datastores

# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# One-time setup for PBS server configuration.
# Creates backup@pbs user, configures ACLs, sets up prune/GC schedules.
#
# Prerequisites:
#   - PBS container (102) running and accessible
#   - PBS root password set
#   - Password stored in 1Password: op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password
#
# Usage:
#   export PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD=$(op read 'op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password')
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="$PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD"
#
# What this playbook does:
#   1. Creates backup@pbs user with DatastoreBackup permissions
#   2. Configures datastore "homelab" (if not exists)
#   3. Sets up prune schedule (7 daily + 4 weekly)
#   4. Configures garbage collection (Sunday 2 AM)
#   5. Verifies configuration
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure Proxmox Backup Server
  hosts: pbs
  gather_facts: false

  vars:
    pbs_datastore: homelab
    pbs_datastore_path: /tank/backups/pbs
    pbs_backup_user: backup@pbs

    prune_keep_daily: 7
    prune_keep_weekly: 4

      ansible.builtin.fail:

    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check PBS API accessibility
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: https://{{ ansible_host }}:8007/api2/json/version
        validate_certs: false
        method: GET
      register: pbs_version
      failed_when: false
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display PBS version
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "PBS Version: {{ pbs_version.json.data.version }}"
      when: pbs_version.status == 200

    - name: Fail if PBS is not accessible
      ansible.builtin.fail:

    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if datastore exists

          --gc-schedule '{{ gc_schedule }}'
          --keep-daily {{ prune_keep_daily }}
          --keep-weekly {{ prune_keep_weekly }}
      when: pbs_datastore in existing_datastores
      register: datastore_updated
      changed_when: datastore_updated.rc == 0

    # Create backup@pbs User

    - name: Check if backup@pbs user exists

    - name: Create backup@pbs user

  description = "LXC container ID"
  type        = number
}

  type        = string

  description = "Path to SSH private key for Proxmox host"
  type        = string
}

# Backup Configuration
# =============================================================================

variable "backup" {
  description = "Backup configuration for PBS client"
  type = object({
    enabled     = bool
    schedule    = string                    # "daily", "02:00", "Sun 03:00"
    retention   = optional(string, "7")     # Keep N backups
    namespace   = string                    # PBS namespace (usually container name)

    # Pre-backup commands (database dumps, etc.)
    pre_backup_commands = optional(list(object({
      name    = string
      command = string
      timeout = optional(number, 300)
    })), [])

    # Paths to backup/exclude
    include_paths = optional(list(string), ["/config"])
    exclude_paths = optional(list(string), ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"])

    ntfy_priority = optional(string, "default")

  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

}

# =============================================================================

resource "ansible_navigator_run" "configure_backup" {

    container_ip        = var.container_ip
    namespace           = var.backup.namespace
    schedule            = var.backup.schedule
    retention           = var.backup.retention
    pre_backup_commands = jsonencode(var.backup.pre_backup_commands)

# This playbook is generated by the lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module.
# It configures proxmox-backup-client for zero-downtime incremental backups.
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure PBS backup for ${container_name}
  hosts: ${container_name}
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    container_id: ${container_id}
    namespace: ${namespace}
    schedule: ${schedule}
    retention: ${retention}
    pbs_server: ${pbs_server}
    pbs_datastore: ${pbs_datastore}
    pbs_user: ${pbs_user}
    pbs_password_cmd: ${pbs_password_cmd}
    pbs_repository: ${pbs_user}@${pbs_server}:${pbs_datastore}

    backup_script_dir: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup
    backup_script_path: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup/backup-${container_id}.sh
    log_dir: /var/log/pbs-backups
    log_file: /var/log/pbs-backups/${namespace}.log

    systemd_service_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.service
    systemd_timer_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.timer

    ntfy_url: ${ntfy_url}
    ntfy_priority: ${ntfy_priority}
    ntfy_tags: ${ntfy_tags}

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Install proxmox-backup-client
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Add Proxmox repository GPG key
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: https://enterprise.proxmox.com/debian/proxmox-release-bookworm.gpg
        dest: /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/proxmox-release-bookworm.gpg
        mode: '0644'

    - name: Add Proxmox repository
      ansible.builtin.apt_repository:
        repo: "deb http://download.proxmox.com/debian/pbs-client bookworm main"
        filename: proxmox-backup-client
        state: present

    - name: Install proxmox-backup-client
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: proxmox-backup-client
        state: present
        update_cache: true

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure PBS Password
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create PBS encryption key directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /root/.config/proxmox-backup
        state: directory
        mode: '0700'

    - name: Store PBS password in environment file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          PBS_REPOSITORY={{ pbs_repository }}
          PBS_NAMESPACE={{ namespace }}
          PBS_PASSWORD={{ lookup('pipe', pbs_password_cmd) }}
        dest: /root/.pbs-backup-env
        mode: '0600'
      no_log: true

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Backup Script
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create backup script directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ backup_script_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Create log directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ log_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Deploy backup script
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          ${indent(10, file("${path.module}/templates/pbs-backup.sh.tftpl"))}
        dest: "{{ backup_script_path }}"
        mode: '0755'

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Systemd Service & Timer
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create systemd service
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=PBS Backup for ${container_name} (${namespace})
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=oneshot
          EnvironmentFile=/root/.pbs-backup-env
          ExecStart={{ backup_script_path }}
          StandardOutput=append:{{ log_file }}
          StandardError=append:{{ log_file }}

          # Resource limits
          CPUQuota=50%
          MemoryMax=1G

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_service_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: service_file

    - name: Determine systemd timer schedule
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        timer_oncalendar: |-
          {%- if schedule == "daily" -%}
          daily
          {%- elif schedule | regex_search('^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$') -%}
          *-*-* {{ schedule }}
          {%- else -%}
          {{ schedule }}
          {%- endif -%}

    - name: Create systemd timer
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Timer for PBS Backup of ${container_name}

          [Timer]
          OnCalendar={{ timer_oncalendar }}
          Persistent=true
          RandomizedDelaySec=5min

          [Install]
          WantedBy=timers.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_timer_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: timer_file

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true
      when: service_file is changed or timer_file is changed

    - name: Enable and start timer
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ systemd_timer_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check timer status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: systemctl status {{ systemd_timer_name }}
      register: timer_status
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Display configuration summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Backup Configured for ${container_name} ==="
          - ""
          - "Container ID: ${container_id}"
          - "Namespace: ${namespace}"
          - "Schedule: {{ timer_oncalendar }}"
          - "Repository: {{ pbs_repository }}"
          - "Log file: {{ log_file }}"
          - ""
          - "Manual trigger:"
          - "  systemctl start {{ systemd_service_name }}"
          - ""
          - "Check timer:"
          - "  systemctl list-timers {{ systemd_timer_name }}"
          - ""
          - "View logs:"
          - "  tail -f {{ log_file }}"

#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# PBS Backup Script for ${container_name} (Container ${container_id})
# =============================================================================
# Generated by lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module
# Namespace: ${namespace}
# Schedule: ${schedule}
# Retention: ${retention} backups
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

# =============================================================================
# Configuration
# =============================================================================

CONTAINER_ID="${container_id}"
NAMESPACE="${namespace}"
RETENTION="${retention}"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/pbs-backups/$${NAMESPACE}.log"

# PBS repository from environment (set by systemd service)
# PBS_REPOSITORY, PBS_NAMESPACE, PBS_PASSWORD

# Backup paths
INCLUDE_PATHS=(
%{ for path in include_paths ~}
  "${path}"
%{ endfor ~}
)

EXCLUDE_PATTERNS=(
%{ for pattern in exclude_paths ~}
  "${pattern}"
%{ endfor ~}
)

# Alert configuration
NTFY_URL="${ntfy_url}"
NTFY_PRIORITY="${ntfy_priority}"
NTFY_TAGS="${ntfy_tags}"

# =============================================================================
# Helper Functions
# =============================================================================

log() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*"
}

send_alert() {
    local title="$1"
    local message="$2"
    local priority="$${3:-$${NTFY_PRIORITY}}"

    curl -sf \
        -H "Title: $${title}" \
        -H "Priority: $${priority}" \
        -H "Tags: $${NTFY_TAGS}" \
        -d "$${message}" \
        "$${NTFY_URL}" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# =============================================================================
# Pre-Backup Commands (Database Dumps, etc.)
# =============================================================================

run_pre_backup_hooks() {
    log "Running pre-backup hooks..."

%{ if length(pre_backup_commands) > 0 ~}
%{ for cmd in pre_backup_commands ~}
    # ${cmd.name}
    log "  - ${cmd.name}"
    if timeout ${cmd.timeout} bash -c '${cmd.command}'; then
        log "    ✓ Success"
    else
        log "    ✗ Failed (exit code: $$?)"
        send_alert "Backup Hook Failed: ${container_name}" \
            "Pre-backup hook failed: ${cmd.name}" \
            "high"
        return 1
    fi

%{ endfor ~}
%{ else ~}
    log "  (No pre-backup hooks configured)"
%{ endif ~}
}

# =============================================================================
# Cleanup Functions
# =============================================================================

cleanup_temp_files() {
    log "Cleaning up temporary dump files..."

%{ if length(pre_backup_commands) > 0 ~}
    # Remove database dumps after successful backup
    find /config -type f \( -name "*.sql.gz" -o -name "*.db.backup" \) -mmin +60 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
%{ endif ~}
}

# =============================================================================
# Main Backup Function
# =============================================================================

run_backup() {
    local backup_name="lxc-$${CONTAINER_ID}/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
    local start_time=$(date +%s)

    log "=== Starting PBS Backup for ${container_name} ==="
    log "Repository: $${PBS_REPOSITORY}"
    log "Namespace: $${PBS_NAMESPACE}"
    log "Backup name: $${backup_name}"

    # Build exclude arguments
    local exclude_args=""
    for pattern in "$${EXCLUDE_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
        exclude_args="$${exclude_args} --exclude '$${pattern}'"
    done

    # Build backup command
    local backup_cmd="proxmox-backup-client backup"

    for path in "$${INCLUDE_PATHS[@]}"; do
        local archive_name=$(basename "$${path}")
        backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} '$${archive_name}.pxar:$${path}'"
    done

    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY"
    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --ns \$PBS_NAMESPACE"
    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --backup-id '$${backup_name}'"

    if [ -n "$${exclude_args}" ]; then
        backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} $${exclude_args}"
    fi

    log "Command: $${backup_cmd}"

    # Run backup
    if eval "$${backup_cmd}"; then
        local end_time=$(date +%s)
        local duration=$((end_time - start_time))

        log "✓ Backup completed successfully in $${duration}s"

        # Prune old backups
        log "Pruning old backups (keep $${RETENTION})..."
        proxmox-backup-client prune \
            --repository "$PBS_REPOSITORY" \
            --ns "$PBS_NAMESPACE" \
            --backup-id "lxc-$${CONTAINER_ID}" \
            --keep-last "$${RETENTION}"

        log "✓ Prune completed"

        # Cleanup temporary files
        cleanup_temp_files

        log "=== Backup Completed Successfully ==="
        return 0
    else
        local exit_code=$$?
        log "✗ Backup failed with exit code: $${exit_code}"

        send_alert "Backup Failed: ${container_name}" \
            "PBS backup failed for ${namespace} (exit code: $${exit_code})" \
            "high"

        return 1
    fi
}

# =============================================================================
# Main Execution
# =============================================================================

main() {
    log "========================================"
    log "PBS Backup: ${container_name}"
    log "Container ID: ${container_id}"
    log "Namespace: ${namespace}"
    log "========================================"

    # Run pre-backup hooks
    if ! run_pre_backup_hooks; then
        log "Pre-backup hooks failed, aborting backup"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Run backup
    if ! run_backup; then
        log "Backup failed"
        exit 1
    fi

    log "All tasks completed successfully"
    exit 0
}

# Run main function
main

input.content:
# LXC Sidecars Module

Manages sidecar services for LXC containers including backup, monitoring, and log collection.

## Features

### Current
- **Backup**: Zero-downtime incremental backups using proxmox-backup-client (PBS)
  - Pre-backup hooks for database dumps
  - Automated pruning and retention
  - File-based logging for future Promtail collection
  - ntfy alerts on failure

### Future
- **DIUN**: Docker image update notifications
- **Promtail**: Log collection for Loki
- **cAdvisor**: Container metrics collection

## Usage

### Basic Backup Configuration

```hcl
module "app_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.app.container_id
  container_ip   = module.app.ip_address
  container_name = "myapp"

  proxmox_ssh_host            = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.proxmox_ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"          # or "02:00" or "Sun 03:00"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "myapp"

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]
  }
}
```

### With Database Pre-Backup Hooks

#### PostgreSQL Example

```hcl
backup = {
  enabled   = true
  schedule  = "daily"
  retention = "7"
  namespace = "immich"

  pre_backup_commands = [{
    name    = "PostgreSQL dump"
    command = "docker exec immich_postgres pg_dump -U immich -d immich --clean --if-exists | gzip > /config/immich-db-backup.sql.gz"
    timeout = 600
  }]

  include_paths = ["/config"]
  exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2", "/config/cache/**"]

  ntfy_priority = "high"
  ntfy_tags     = "backup,immich,rotating_light"
}
```

#### SQLite Example

```hcl
backup = {
  enabled   = true
  schedule  = "daily"
  retention = "7"
  namespace = "openwebui"

  pre_backup_commands = [{
    name    = "SQLite backup"

# LXC Sidecars Module

Manages sidecar services for LXC containers including backup, monitoring, and log collection.

## Features

### Current
- **Backup**: Zero-downtime incremental backups using proxmox-backup-client (PBS)
  - Pre-backup hooks for database dumps
  - Automated pruning and retention
  - File-based logging for future Promtail collection
  - ntfy alerts on failure

- **DIUN**: Docker image update notifications
- **Promtail**: Log collection for Loki
- **cAdvisor**: Container metrics collection

### Basic Backup Configuration

```hcl
module "app_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.app.container_id
  container_ip   = module.app.ip_address
  container_name = "myapp"

  proxmox_ssh_host            = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.proxmox_ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"          # or "02:00" or "Sun 03:00"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "myapp"

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

}

    timeout = 600

  include_paths = ["/config"]
  exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2", "/config/cache/**"]

  ntfy_priority = "high"
  ntfy_tags     = "backup,immich,rotating_light"
}

### PBS Management

#### `pbs-configure-jobs.yml`

Configure Proxmox Backup Server (PBS) backup jobs.

**Tags:**

- `configure`: Create/update backup jobs in Proxmox
- `verify`: Verify existing backup job configuration

**Examples:**

```bash
# Configure PBS backup jobs
ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml --tags configure

# Verify current configuration
ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml --tags verify
```

**Features:**

- Configures two backup schedules:
  - **Daily** (2 AM): User data containers (immich, openwebui, n8n, obsidian-sync, documents)
  - **Weekly** (Sunday 3 AM): Infrastructure containers (traefik, portainer, authelia, etc.)
- Uses PBS storage (`pbs-homelab`) with proper retention policies
- Automatically includes pre-backup hooks if available
- Excludes PBS container (102) and temporary containers (600)

**Backup Strategy:**

- Daily backups: Keep 7 days
- Weekly backups: Keep 4 weeks
- All backups use snapshot mode with zstd compression

### PBS Management

#### `pbs-setup-server.yml`

One-time setup for Proxmox Backup Server (PBS) configuration.

**Purpose:** Configure PBS server with backup user, ACLs, and prune/GC schedules.

- PBS container (102) running
- PBS password in 1Password: `op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password`

```bash
# Setup PBS server

ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="$PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD"

# Test authentication
ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="$PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD" --tags test
```

**What it does:**
1. Creates `backup@pbs` user with DatastoreBackup permissions
2. Configures datastore "homelab" at `/tank/backups/pbs`
3. Sets up prune schedule (keep 7 daily + 4 weekly)

# Ansible Automation for Homelab

Operational automation playbooks for backup, monitoring, and day-2 operations.

## 📁 Directory Structure

```
ansible/
├── ansible.cfg              # Ansible configuration
├── inventory/
│   └── hosts.yml           # Static inventory (all LXCs + Proxmox)
├── playbooks/              # Standalone playbooks
│   ├── backup-all.yml      # Backup all containers
│   ├── backup-lxc.yml      # Backup specific containers
│   └── backup-immich-db.yml # Backup Immich database
├── roles/                  # Reusable roles (future)
├── group_vars/            # Group-specific variables
└── host_vars/             # Host-specific variables
```

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Prerequisites

```bash
# Install ansible-navigator (already installed via uv)
uv tool install ansible-navigator

# Verify SSH access
ssh root@homelab
```

### Running Playbooks

All commands run from the `ansible/` directory:

```bash
cd ansible

# Backup all containers
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml

# Backup specific containers
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich,jellyfin
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e container_id=304

# Backup Immich database
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-immich-db.yml
```

## 📋 Available Playbooks

### Backup Operations

#### `backup-all.yml`
Backup all LXC containers using vzdump.

**Options:**
- `backup_storage`: Storage target (default: `backup-tank`)
- `backup_mode`: Backup mode (default: `snapshot`)
- `backup_compress`: Compression (default: `zstd`)

**Examples:**
```bash
# Standard backup to backup-tank
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml

# Backup to PBS
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml -e backup_storage=pbs

# Run only pre-backup hooks
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml --tags pre-backup
```

**Replaces:** `scripts/backup/backup-all.sh`

---

#### `backup-lxc.yml`
Backup specific containers by hostname or container ID.

**Required:**
- `target`: Comma-separated hostnames (e.g., `immich,jellyfin`)
- OR `container_id`: Single container ID

**Examples:**
```bash
# Backup by hostname
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich

# Backup multiple containers
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich,jellyfin,traefik

# Backup by container ID
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e container_id=304
```

**Replaces:** `scripts/backup/backup-app.sh`

---

#### `backup-immich-db.yml`
Create PostgreSQL database dump for Immich.

**Options:**
- `backup_dir`: Backup directory (default: `/photos/immich-backups`)
- `retention_days`: Days to keep old backups (default: `7`)

**Examples:**
```bash
# Standard database backup
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-immich-db.yml

# Custom backup location
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-immich-db.yml -e backup_dir=/custom/path

# Longer retention
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-immich-db.yml -e retention_days=30
```

**Replaces:** `scripts/backup/immich-db.sh`

---

## 🎯 Inventory

The inventory is defined in [inventory/hosts.yml](inventory/hosts.yml) and mirrors the IP registry from OpenTofu ([tofu/apps/traefik/ip-registry.tf](../tofu/apps/traefik/ip-registry.tf)).

### Groups

- `proxmox`: Proxmox VE host
- `lxc`: All LXC containers
  - `core`: Portainer, network-services, PBS
  - `dashboards`: Traefik, Homepage, Authelia
  - `photos`: Immich, immich-importer
  - `media`: Jellyfin, media-management
  - `monitoring`: Monitoring, OpenWebUI, n8n, Obsidian, Documents
- `backup_containers`: Containers to include in backups
- `docker_containers`: Containers running Docker Compose

### Viewing Inventory

```bash
# List all hosts
ansible-inventory --list

# List specific group
ansible-inventory --graph backup_containers

# Show host details
ansible-inventory --host immich
```

## 🔧 Testing Connectivity

```bash
# Ping all hosts
ansible all -m ping

# Ping specific group
ansible backup_containers -m ping

# Run command on all LXCs
ansible lxc -a "uptime"
```

## 📝 Configuration

The [ansible.cfg](ansible.cfg) file configures:
- Inventory location
- SSH settings (uses `~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519`)
- Output formatting (YAML)
- Performance tuning (10 forks, fact caching)
- Logging (`/tmp/ansible.log`)

## 🆚 Comparison: Bash vs Ansible

### Before (Bash)
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scripts/backup/backup-all.sh

source "$SCRIPT_DIR/containers.sh"
ssh root@homelab "vzdump $ALL_BACKUP_CONTAINERS --storage backup-tank --mode snapshot --compress zstd"
```

**Issues:**
- No error handling
- Manual container list management
- No idempotency
- Limited logging

### After (Ansible)
```yaml
# playbooks/backup-all.yml

- name: Backup all LXC containers
  hosts: proxmox
  tasks:
    - name: Run vzdump backup
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: vzdump {{ container_ids | join(' ') }} ...
      register: backup_result
```

**Benefits:**
- ✅ Automatic inventory from hosts.yml
- ✅ Error handling built-in
- ✅ Idempotent operations
- ✅ Structured logging
- ✅ Dry-run support (`--check`)
- ✅ Tags for selective execution

---

### Temporary Infrastructure

#### `desktop-lxc.yml`
Create/destroy temporary desktop LXC for Google Takeout downloads.

**Tags:**
- `create`: Create desktop LXC with XFCE + VNC + Chrome
- `destroy`: Destroy desktop LXC

**Examples:**
```bash
# Create desktop
ansible-playbook playbooks/desktop-lxc.yml --tags create

# Destroy desktop

- TigerVNC server on port 5901
- Google Chrome pre-installed
- NAS mount at /downloads → /tank/photo-import

**Replaces:** `scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh`, `scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh`

---

#### `pbs-configure-jobs.yml`

**Tags:**

- `verify`: Verify existing backup job configuration

```bash

  - **Daily** (2 AM): User data containers (immich, openwebui, n8n, obsidian-sync, documents)
  - **Weekly** (Sunday 3 AM): Infrastructure containers (traefik, portainer, authelia, etc.)
- Uses PBS storage (`pbs-homelab`) with proper retention policies
- Automatically includes pre-backup hooks if available
- Excludes PBS container (102) and temporary containers (600)

**Backup Strategy:**

- Daily backups: Keep 7 days
- Weekly backups: Keep 4 weeks
- All backups use snapshot mode with zstd compression

---

## 🔮 Future Playbooks

Planned additions:
- `cloud-sync.yml` - Sync backups to cloud storage (B2)
- `container-update.yml` - Update Docker images across containers
- `monitoring-check.yml` - Health checks for all services
- `certificate-renew.yml` - Force certificate renewal
- `pbs-verify.yml` - Trigger PBS verification jobs
- `pbs-status.yml` - Check PBS backup health

- [ansible-navigator](https://ansible.readthedocs.io/projects/navigator/)
- [Proxmox VE Ansible Modules](https://docs.ansible.com/ansible/latest/collections/community/general/proxmox_module.html)

# Ansible Automation for Homelab

Operational automation playbooks for backup, monitoring, and day-2 operations.

## 📁 Directory Structure

```
ansible/
├── ansible.cfg              # Ansible configuration
├── inventory/
│   └── hosts.yml           # Static inventory (all LXCs + Proxmox)
├── playbooks/              # Standalone playbooks
│   ├── backup-all.yml      # Backup all containers
│   ├── backup-lxc.yml      # Backup specific containers
│   └── backup-immich-db.yml # Backup Immich database
├── roles/                  # Reusable roles (future)
├── group_vars/            # Group-specific variables
└── host_vars/             # Host-specific variables
```

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Prerequisites

```bash
# Install ansible-navigator (already installed via uv)
uv tool install ansible-navigator

# Verify SSH access
ssh root@homelab
```

### Running Playbooks

All commands run from the `ansible/` directory:

```bash
cd ansible

# Backup all containers
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml

# Backup specific containers
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich,jellyfin
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e container_id=304

# Backup Immich database
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-immich-db.yml
```

## 📋 Available Playbooks

### Backup Operations

#### `backup-all.yml`
Backup all LXC containers using vzdump.

**Options:**
- `backup_storage`: Storage target (default: `backup-tank`)
- `backup_mode`: Backup mode (default: `snapshot`)
- `backup_compress`: Compression (default: `zstd`)

**Examples:**
```bash
# Standard backup to backup-tank
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml

# Backup to PBS
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml -e backup_storage=pbs

# Run only pre-backup hooks
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml --tags pre-backup
```

**Replaces:** `scripts/backup/backup-all.sh`

---

#### `backup-lxc.yml`
Backup specific containers by hostname or container ID.

**Required:**
- `target`: Comma-separated hostnames (e.g., `immich,jellyfin`)
- OR `container_id`: Single container ID

**Examples:**
```bash
# Backup by hostname
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich

# Backup multiple containers
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich,jellyfin,traefik

# Backup by container ID
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e container_id=304
```

**Replaces:** `scripts/backup/backup-app.sh`

---

#### `backup-immich-db.yml`
Create PostgreSQL database dump for Immich.

**Options:**
- `backup_dir`: Backup directory (default: `/photos/immich-backups`)
- `retention_days`: Days to keep old backups (default: `7`)

**Examples:**
```bash
# Standard database backup
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-immich-db.yml

# Custom backup location
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-immich-db.yml -e backup_dir=/custom/path

# Longer retention
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-immich-db.yml -e retention_days=30
```

**Replaces:** `scripts/backup/immich-db.sh`

---

## 🎯 Inventory

The inventory is defined in [inventory/hosts.yml](inventory/hosts.yml) and mirrors the IP registry from OpenTofu ([tofu/apps/traefik/ip-registry.tf](../tofu/apps/traefik/ip-registry.tf)).

### Groups

- `proxmox`: Proxmox VE host
- `lxc`: All LXC containers
  - `core`: Portainer, network-services, PBS
  - `dashboards`: Traefik, Homepage, Authelia
  - `photos`: Immich, immich-importer
  - `media`: Jellyfin, media-management
  - `monitoring`: Monitoring, OpenWebUI, n8n, Obsidian, Documents
- `backup_containers`: Containers to include in backups
- `docker_containers`: Containers running Docker Compose

### Viewing Inventory

```bash
# List all hosts
ansible-inventory --list

# List specific group
ansible-inventory --graph backup_containers

# Show host details
ansible-inventory --host immich
```

## 🔧 Testing Connectivity

```bash
# Ping all hosts
ansible all -m ping

# Ping specific group
ansible backup_containers -m ping

# Run command on all LXCs
ansible lxc -a "uptime"
```

## 📝 Configuration

The [ansible.cfg](ansible.cfg) file configures:
- Inventory location
- SSH settings (uses `~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519`)
- Output formatting (YAML)
- Performance tuning (10 forks, fact caching)
- Logging (`/tmp/ansible.log`)

## 🆚 Comparison: Bash vs Ansible

### Before (Bash)
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scripts/backup/backup-all.sh

source "$SCRIPT_DIR/containers.sh"
ssh root@homelab "vzdump $ALL_BACKUP_CONTAINERS --storage backup-tank --mode snapshot --compress zstd"
```

**Issues:**
- No error handling
- Manual container list management
- No idempotency
- Limited logging

### After (Ansible)
```yaml
# playbooks/backup-all.yml

- name: Backup all LXC containers
  hosts: proxmox
  tasks:
    - name: Run vzdump backup
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: vzdump {{ container_ids | join(' ') }} ...
      register: backup_result
```

**Benefits:**
- ✅ Automatic inventory from hosts.yml
- ✅ Error handling built-in
- ✅ Idempotent operations
- ✅ Structured logging
- ✅ Dry-run support (`--check`)
- ✅ Tags for selective execution

---

### Temporary Infrastructure

#### `desktop-lxc.yml`
Create/destroy temporary desktop LXC for Google Takeout downloads.

**Tags:**
- `create`: Create desktop LXC with XFCE + VNC + Chrome
- `destroy`: Destroy desktop LXC

**Examples:**
```bash
# Create desktop
ansible-playbook playbooks/desktop-lxc.yml --tags create

# Destroy desktop
ansible-playbook playbooks/desktop-lxc.yml --tags destroy
```

**Features:**
- Ubuntu 24.04 LXC with XFCE desktop
- TigerVNC server on port 5901
- Google Chrome pre-installed
- NAS mount at /downloads → /tank/photo-import
- Random VNC password generated on creation

**Replaces:** `scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh`, `scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh`

---

### PBS Management

#### `pbs-setup-server.yml`

One-time setup for Proxmox Backup Server (PBS) configuration.

**Purpose:** Configure PBS server with backup user, ACLs, and prune/GC schedules.

**Prerequisites:**

- PBS container (102) running
- PBS password in 1Password: `op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password`

**Examples:**

```bash
# Setup PBS server
export PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD=$(op read 'op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password')
ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="$PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD"

# Test authentication
ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="$PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD" --tags test
```

**What it does:**
1. Creates `backup@pbs` user with DatastoreBackup permissions
2. Configures datastore "homelab" at `/tank/backups/pbs`
3. Sets up prune schedule (keep 7 daily + 4 weekly)
4. Configures garbage collection (Sunday 2 AM)
5. Verifies configuration

**Note:** This is a one-time setup playbook. After running once, use the `lxc-sidecars` OpenTofu module to configure individual container backups.

---

#### `pbs-configure-jobs.yml`

Configure Proxmox vzdump backup jobs (legacy, being migrated to PBS client).

**Tags:**

- `configure`: Create/update backup jobs in Proxmox
- `verify`: Verify existing backup job configuration

**Examples:**

```bash
# Configure PBS backup jobs
ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml --tags configure

# Verify current configuration
ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml --tags verify
```

**Features:**

- Configures two backup schedules:
  - **Daily** (2 AM): User data containers (immich, openwebui, n8n, obsidian-sync, documents)
  - **Weekly** (Sunday 3 AM): Infrastructure containers (traefik, portainer, authelia, etc.)
- Uses PBS storage (`pbs-homelab`) with proper retention policies
- Automatically includes pre-backup hooks if available
- Excludes PBS container (102) and temporary containers (600)

**Backup Strategy:**

- Daily backups: Keep 7 days
- Weekly backups: Keep 4 weeks
- All backups use snapshot mode with zstd compression

**Migration Status:** This playbook configures vzdump (snapshot mode with brief downtime). Migrating to proxmox-backup-client (zero-downtime) via `lxc-sidecars` OpenTofu module.

---

## 🔮 Future Playbooks

Planned additions:
- `cloud-sync.yml` - Sync backups to cloud storage (B2)
- `container-update.yml` - Update Docker images across containers
- `monitoring-check.yml` - Health checks for all services
- `certificate-renew.yml` - Force certificate renewal
- `pbs-verify.yml` - Trigger PBS verification jobs
- `pbs-status.yml` - Check PBS backup health

## 📚 Resources

- [Ansible Documentation](https://docs.ansible.com/)
- [ansible-navigator](https://ansible.readthedocs.io/projects/navigator/)
- [Proxmox VE Ansible Modules](https://docs.ansible.com/ansible/latest/collections/community/general/proxmox_module.html)

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure Proxmox Backup Server (PBS)
# =============================================================================
# One-time setup for PBS server configuration.
# Creates backup@pbs user, configures ACLs, sets up prune/GC schedules.
#
# Prerequisites:
#   - PBS container (102) running and accessible
#   - PBS root password set
#   - Password stored in 1Password: op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password
#
# Usage:
#   export PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD=$(op read 'op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password')
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="$PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD"
#
# What this playbook does:
#   1. Creates backup@pbs user with DatastoreBackup permissions
#   2. Configures datastore "homelab" (if not exists)
#   3. Sets up prune schedule (7 daily + 4 weekly)
#   4. Configures garbage collection (Sunday 2 AM)
#   5. Verifies configuration
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure Proxmox Backup Server
  hosts: pbs
  gather_facts: false

  vars:
    pbs_datastore: homelab
    pbs_datastore_path: /tank/backups/pbs
    pbs_backup_user: backup@pbs

    # Prune settings
    prune_keep_daily: 7
    prune_keep_weekly: 4

    # GC schedule (Sunday 2 AM)
    gc_schedule: "sun 02:00"

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Verify PBS backup password is provided
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: |
          PBS backup password not provided!
          Usage: ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="PASSWORD"
          Get password: op read 'op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password'
      when: pbs_backup_password is not defined or pbs_backup_password == ""

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Verify PBS is accessible
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check PBS API accessibility
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: https://{{ ansible_host }}:8007/api2/json/version
        validate_certs: false
        method: GET
      register: pbs_version
      failed_when: false
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display PBS version
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "PBS Version: {{ pbs_version.json.data.version }}"
      when: pbs_version.status == 200

    - name: Fail if PBS is not accessible
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: "PBS API not accessible at https://{{ ansible_host }}:8007"
      when: pbs_version.status != 200

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Datastore (if not exists)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if datastore exists
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager datastore list --output-format json
      register: datastore_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse datastore list
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        existing_datastores: "{{ datastore_list.stdout | from_json | map(attribute='name') | list }}"

    - name: Create datastore if not exists
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager datastore create {{ pbs_datastore }}
          --path {{ pbs_datastore_path }}
          --gc-schedule '{{ gc_schedule }}'
          --keep-daily {{ prune_keep_daily }}
          --keep-weekly {{ prune_keep_weekly }}
      when: pbs_datastore not in existing_datastores
      register: datastore_created

    - name: Display datastore creation result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Datastore '{{ pbs_datastore }}' created at {{ pbs_datastore_path }}"
      when: datastore_created is changed

    - name: Update existing datastore settings
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager datastore update {{ pbs_datastore }}
          --gc-schedule '{{ gc_schedule }}'
          --keep-daily {{ prune_keep_daily }}
          --keep-weekly {{ prune_keep_weekly }}
      when: pbs_datastore in existing_datastores
      register: datastore_updated
      changed_when: datastore_updated.rc == 0

    # =========================================================================
    # Create backup@pbs User
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if backup@pbs user exists
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager user list --output-format json
      register: user_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse user list
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        existing_users: "{{ user_list.stdout | from_json | map(attribute='userid') | list }}"

    - name: Create backup@pbs user
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager user create {{ pbs_backup_user }}
          --password '{{ pbs_backup_password }}'
      when: pbs_backup_user not in existing_users
      register: user_created
      no_log: true

    - name: Update backup@pbs user password
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager user update {{ pbs_backup_user }}
          --password '{{ pbs_backup_password }}'
      when: pbs_backup_user in existing_users
      register: user_updated
      changed_when: user_updated.rc == 0
      no_log: true

    - name: Display user creation result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "User '{{ pbs_backup_user }}' {{ 'created' if user_created is changed else 'updated' }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure ACLs for backup@pbs user
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check existing ACLs
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager acl list --output-format json
      register: acl_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse ACL list
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        existing_acls: "{{ acl_list.stdout | from_json }}"

    - name: Check if DatastoreBackup ACL exists for user
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        acl_exists: "{{ existing_acls | selectattr('ugid', 'equalto', pbs_backup_user) | selectattr('path', 'equalto', '/datastore/' + pbs_datastore) | list | length > 0 }}"

    - name: Grant DatastoreBackup permission to backup@pbs
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager acl update /datastore/{{ pbs_datastore }}
          --auth-id {{ pbs_backup_user }}
          --role DatastoreBackup
      when: not acl_exists
      register: acl_created

    - name: Display ACL creation result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "ACL granted: {{ pbs_backup_user }} → DatastoreBackup on /datastore/{{ pbs_datastore }}"
      when: acl_created is changed

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Get final datastore configuration
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager datastore list --output-format json
      register: final_datastores
      changed_when: false

    - name: Get final user list
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager user list --output-format json
      register: final_users
      changed_when: false

    - name: Get final ACL list
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager acl list --output-format json
      register: final_acls
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse final configuration
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        datastore_config: "{{ final_datastores.stdout | from_json | selectattr('name', 'equalto', pbs_datastore) | first }}"
        user_config: "{{ final_users.stdout | from_json | selectattr('userid', 'equalto', pbs_backup_user) | first }}"
        acl_config: "{{ final_acls.stdout | from_json | selectattr('ugid', 'equalto', pbs_backup_user) | selectattr('path', 'equalto', '/datastore/' + pbs_datastore) | list }}"

    - name: Display PBS configuration summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Server Configuration Complete ==="
          - ""
          - "Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}"
          - "  Path: {{ datastore_config.path }}"
          - "  GC Schedule: {{ datastore_config['gc-schedule'] | default('Not set') }}"
          - "  Prune Policy:"
          - "    - Keep Daily: {{ prune_keep_daily }}"
          - "    - Keep Weekly: {{ prune_keep_weekly }}"
          - ""
          - "User: {{ pbs_backup_user }}"
          - "  Enabled: {{ user_config.enable | default(true) }}"
          - "  Permissions: DatastoreBackup on /datastore/{{ pbs_datastore }}"
          - ""
          - "ACLs:"
          - "{{ acl_config }}"
          - ""
          - "Next steps:"
          - "  1. Verify in PBS UI: https://{{ ansible_host }}:8007"
          - "  2. Test backup from LXC client:"
          - "     proxmox-backup-client backup --repository {{ pbs_backup_user }}@{{ ansible_host }}:{{ pbs_datastore }}"
          - "  3. Create lxc-sidecars module and configure containers"

    # =========================================================================
    # Test Connection (Optional)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Test backup user authentication
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          export PBS_PASSWORD='{{ pbs_backup_password }}'
          proxmox-backup-client login --repository {{ pbs_backup_user }}@{{ ansible_host }}:{{ pbs_datastore }}
      register: login_test
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false
      no_log: true
      when: test_auth is defined and test_auth | bool
      tags: [never, test]

    - name: Display authentication test result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Authentication test: {{ 'SUCCESS' if login_test.rc == 0 else 'FAILED - ' + login_test.stderr }}"
      when: test_auth is defined and test_auth | bool
      tags: [never, test]

  type = object({
    enabled     = bool

    retention   = optional(string, "7")     # Keep N backups

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure Proxmox Backup Server (PBS)
# =============================================================================
# One-time setup for PBS server configuration.
# Creates backup@pbs user, configures ACLs, sets up prune/GC schedules.
#
# Prerequisites:
#   - PBS container (102) running and accessible
#   - PBS root password set
#   - Password stored in 1Password: op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password
#
# Usage:
#   export PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD=$(op read 'op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password')
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="$PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD"
#
# What this playbook does:
#   1. Creates backup@pbs user with DatastoreBackup permissions
#   2. Configures datastore "homelab" (if not exists)
#   3. Sets up prune schedule (7 daily + 4 weekly)
#   4. Configures garbage collection (Sunday 2 AM)
#   5. Verifies configuration
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure Proxmox Backup Server
  hosts: pbs
  gather_facts: false

  vars:
    pbs_datastore: homelab
    pbs_datastore_path: /tank/backups/pbs
    pbs_backup_user: backup@pbs

    # Prune settings
    prune_keep_daily: 7
    prune_keep_weekly: 4

    # GC schedule (Sunday 2 AM)
    gc_schedule: "sun 02:00"

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Verify PBS backup password is provided
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: |
          PBS backup password not provided!
          Usage: ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="PASSWORD"
          Get password: op read 'op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password'
      when: pbs_backup_password is not defined or pbs_backup_password == ""

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Verify PBS is accessible
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check PBS version
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager version
      register: pbs_version
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display PBS version
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ pbs_version.stdout }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Datastore (if not exists)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if datastore exists
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager datastore list --output-format json
      register: datastore_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse datastore list
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        existing_datastores: "{{ datastore_list.stdout | from_json | map(attribute='name') | list }}"

    - name: Create datastore if not exists
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager datastore create {{ pbs_datastore }}
          --path {{ pbs_datastore_path }}
          --gc-schedule '{{ gc_schedule }}'
          --keep-daily {{ prune_keep_daily }}
          --keep-weekly {{ prune_keep_weekly }}
      when: pbs_datastore not in existing_datastores
      register: datastore_created

    - name: Display datastore creation result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Datastore '{{ pbs_datastore }}' created at {{ pbs_datastore_path }}"
      when: datastore_created is changed

    - name: Update existing datastore settings
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager datastore update {{ pbs_datastore }}
          --gc-schedule '{{ gc_schedule }}'
          --keep-daily {{ prune_keep_daily }}
          --keep-weekly {{ prune_keep_weekly }}

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure Proxmox Backup Server (PBS)
# =============================================================================
# One-time setup for PBS server configuration.
# Creates backup@pbs user, configures ACLs, sets up prune/GC schedules.
#
# Prerequisites:
#   - PBS container (102) running and accessible
#   - PBS root password set
#   - Password stored in 1Password: op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password
#
# Usage:
#   export PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD=$(op read 'op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password')
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="$PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD"
#
# What this playbook does:
#   1. Creates backup@pbs user with DatastoreBackup permissions
#   2. Configures datastore "homelab" (if not exists)
#   3. Sets up prune schedule (7 daily + 4 weekly)
#   4. Configures garbage collection (Sunday 2 AM)
#   5. Verifies configuration
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure Proxmox Backup Server
  hosts: pbs
  gather_facts: false

  vars:
    pbs_datastore: homelab
    pbs_datastore_path: /tank/backups/pbs
    pbs_backup_user: backup@pbs

    # Prune settings
    prune_keep_daily: 7
    prune_keep_weekly: 4

    # GC schedule (Sunday 2 AM)
    gc_schedule: "sun 02:00"

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Verify PBS backup password is provided
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: |
          PBS backup password not provided!
          Usage: ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="PASSWORD"
          Get password: op read 'op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password'
      when: pbs_backup_password is not defined or pbs_backup_password == ""

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Verify PBS is accessible
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check PBS version
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager version
      register: pbs_version
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display PBS version
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ pbs_version.stdout }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Datastore (if not exists)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if datastore exists
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager datastore list --output-format json
      register: datastore_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse datastore list
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        existing_datastores: "{{ datastore_list.stdout | from_json | map(attribute='name') | list }}"

    - name: Create datastore if not exists
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager datastore create {{ pbs_datastore }}
          --path {{ pbs_datastore_path }}
          --gc-schedule '{{ gc_schedule }}'
      when: pbs_datastore not in existing_datastores
      register: datastore_created

    - name: Display datastore creation result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Datastore '{{ pbs_datastore }}' created at {{ pbs_datastore_path }}"
      when: datastore_created is changed

    - name: Update datastore GC schedule
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager datastore update {{ pbs_datastore }}
          --gc-schedule '{{ gc_schedule }}'
      when: pbs_datastore in existing_datastores
      register: datastore_updated
      changed_when: datastore_updated.rc == 0

    # =========================================================================
    # Create backup@pbs User
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if backup@pbs user exists
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager user list --output-format json
      register: user_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse user list
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        existing_users: "{{ user_list.stdout | from_json | map(attribute='userid') | list }}"

    - name: Create backup@pbs user
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager user create {{ pbs_backup_user }}
          --password '{{ pbs_backup_password }}'
      when: pbs_backup_user not in existing_users
      register: user_created
      no_log: true

    - name: Update backup@pbs user password
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager user update {{ pbs_backup_user }}
          --password '{{ pbs_backup_password }}'
      when: pbs_backup_user in existing_users
      register: user_updated
      changed_when: user_updated.rc == 0
      no_log: true

    - name: Display user creation result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "User '{{ pbs_backup_user }}' {{ 'created' if user_created is changed else 'updated' }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure ACLs for backup@pbs user
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check existing ACLs
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager acl list --output-format json
      register: acl_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse ACL list
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        existing_acls: "{{ acl_list.stdout | from_json }}"

    - name: Check if DatastoreBackup ACL exists for user
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        acl_exists: "{{ existing_acls | selectattr('ugid', 'equalto', pbs_backup_user) | selectattr('path', 'equalto', '/datastore/' + pbs_datastore) | list | length > 0 }}"

    - name: Grant DatastoreBackup permission to backup@pbs
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager acl update /datastore/{{ pbs_datastore }}
          --auth-id {{ pbs_backup_user }}
          --role DatastoreBackup
      when: not acl_exists
      register: acl_created

    - name: Display ACL creation result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "ACL granted: {{ pbs_backup_user }} → DatastoreBackup on /datastore/{{ pbs_datastore }}"
      when: acl_created is changed

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Get final datastore configuration
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager datastore list --output-format json
      register: final_datastores
      changed_when: false

    - name: Get final user list
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager user list --output-format json
      register: final_users
      changed_when: false

    - name: Get final ACL list
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager acl list --output-format json
      register: final_acls
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse final configuration
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        datastore_config: "{{ final_datastores.stdout | from_json | selectattr('name', 'equalto', pbs_datastore) | first }}"
        user_config: "{{ final_users.stdout | from_json | selectattr('userid', 'equalto', pbs_backup_user) | first }}"
        acl_config: "{{ final_acls.stdout | from_json | selectattr('ugid', 'equalto', pbs_backup_user) | selectattr('path', 'equalto', '/datastore/' + pbs_datastore) | list }}"

    - name: Display PBS configuration summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Server Configuration Complete ==="
          - ""
          - "Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}"
          - "  Path: {{ datastore_config.path }}"
          - "  GC Schedule: {{ datastore_config['gc-schedule'] | default('Not set') }}"
          - "  Prune Policy:"
          - "    - Keep Daily: {{ prune_keep_daily }}"
          - "    - Keep Weekly: {{ prune_keep_weekly }}"
          - ""
          - "User: {{ pbs_backup_user }}"
          - "  Enabled: {{ user_config.enable | default(true) }}"
          - "  Permissions: DatastoreBackup on /datastore/{{ pbs_datastore }}"
          - ""
          - "ACLs:"
          - "{{ acl_config }}"
          - ""
          - "Next steps:"
          - "  1. Verify in PBS UI: https://{{ ansible_host }}:8007"
          - "  2. Test backup from LXC client:"
          - "     proxmox-backup-client backup --repository {{ pbs_backup_user }}@{{ ansible_host }}:{{ pbs_datastore }}"
          - "  3. Create lxc-sidecars module and configure containers"

    # =========================================================================
    # Test Connection (Optional)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Test backup user authentication
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          export PBS_PASSWORD='{{ pbs_backup_password }}'
          proxmox-backup-client login --repository {{ pbs_backup_user }}@{{ ansible_host }}:{{ pbs_datastore }}
      register: login_test
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false
      no_log: true
      when: test_auth is defined and test_auth | bool
      tags: [never, test]

    - name: Display authentication test result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Authentication test: {{ 'SUCCESS' if login_test.rc == 0 else 'FAILED - ' + login_test.stderr }}"
      when: test_auth is defined and test_auth | bool
      tags: [never, test]
