---
# =============================================================================
# Configure PBS Backup Client in LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# This playbook is generated by the lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module.
# It configures proxmox-backup-client for zero-downtime incremental backups.
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure PBS backup for ${container_name}
  hosts: ${container_name}
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    container_id: ${container_id}
    namespace: ${namespace}
    schedule: ${schedule}
    retention: ${retention}
    pbs_server: ${pbs_server}
    pbs_datastore: ${pbs_datastore}
    pbs_user: ${pbs_user}
    pbs_password_cmd: ${pbs_password_cmd}
    pbs_repository: ${pbs_user}@${pbs_server}:${pbs_datastore}

    backup_script_dir: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup
    backup_script_path: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup/backup-${container_id}.sh
    log_dir: /var/log/pbs-backups
    log_file: /var/log/pbs-backups/${namespace}.log

    systemd_service_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.service
    systemd_timer_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.timer

    ntfy_url: ${ntfy_url}
    ntfy_priority: ${ntfy_priority}
    ntfy_tags: ${ntfy_tags}

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Install proxmox-backup-client
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if proxmox-backup-client is already installed
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: which proxmox-backup-client
      register: pbs_client_check
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Install proxmox-backup-client dependencies
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - curl
          - ca-certificates
        state: present
        update_cache: true
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Download proxmox-backup-client binary
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: https://cloud-pbs.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/proxmox-backup-client
        dest: /usr/local/bin/proxmox-backup-client
        mode: '0755'
        checksum: sha256:85b477e2f17b86947f332cfe71ccfc365e1c9821a7a748899b13fcffbcd0c8f9
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Verify proxmox-backup-client installation
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-client version
      register: pbs_version_check
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display proxmox-backup-client version
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ pbs_version_check.stdout }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure PBS Password
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create PBS encryption key directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /root/.config/proxmox-backup
        state: directory
        mode: '0700'

    - name: Get PBS certificate fingerprint
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          ssh root@{{ pbs_server }} "proxmox-backup-manager cert info" | \
          grep "Fingerprint (sha256):" | \
          awk '{print $NF}'
      register: pbs_fingerprint
      changed_when: false
      delegate_to: localhost

    - name: Store PBS password and fingerprint in environment file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          PBS_REPOSITORY={{ pbs_repository }}
          PBS_NAMESPACE={{ namespace }}
          PBS_PASSWORD={{ lookup('pipe', pbs_password_cmd) }}
          PBS_FINGERPRINT={{ pbs_fingerprint.stdout }}
        dest: /root/.pbs-backup-env
        mode: '0600'
      no_log: true

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Backup Script
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create backup script directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ backup_script_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Create log directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ log_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Deploy backup script
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          ${indent(10, backup_script)}
        dest: "{{ backup_script_path }}"
        mode: '0755'

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Systemd Service & Timer
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create systemd service
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=PBS Backup for ${container_name} (${namespace})
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=oneshot
          EnvironmentFile=/root/.pbs-backup-env
          ExecStart={{ backup_script_path }}
          StandardOutput=append:{{ log_file }}
          StandardError=append:{{ log_file }}

          # Resource limits
          CPUQuota=50%
          MemoryMax=1G

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_service_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: service_file

    - name: Determine systemd timer schedule
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        timer_oncalendar: |-
          {%- if schedule == "daily" -%}
          daily
          {%- elif schedule | regex_search('^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$') -%}
          *-*-* {{ schedule }}
          {%- else -%}
          {{ schedule }}
          {%- endif -%}

    - name: Create systemd timer
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Timer for PBS Backup of ${container_name}

          [Timer]
          OnCalendar={{ timer_oncalendar }}
          Persistent=true
          RandomizedDelaySec=5min

          [Install]
          WantedBy=timers.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_timer_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: timer_file

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true
      when: service_file is changed or timer_file is changed

    - name: Enable and start timer
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ systemd_timer_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check timer status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: systemctl status {{ systemd_timer_name }}
      register: timer_status
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Display configuration summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Backup Configured for ${container_name} ==="
          - ""
          - "Container ID: ${container_id}"
          - "Namespace: ${namespace}"
          - "Schedule: {{ timer_oncalendar }}"
          - "Repository: {{ pbs_repository }}"
          - "Log file: {{ log_file }}"
          - ""
          - "Manual trigger:"
          - "  systemctl start {{ systemd_service_name }}"
          - ""
          - "Check timer:"
          - "  systemctl list-timers {{ systemd_timer_name }}"
          - ""
          - "View logs:"
          - "  tail -f {{ log_file }}"

# =============================================================================
# n8n LXC - Workflow Automation
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 502
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Plus traefik-route module for self-service routing.
# =============================================================================

module "n8n" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  # Identity
  name         = "n8n"
  container_id = 502

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores          = 2
  memory         = 2048
  swap           = 1024
  rootfs_size    = 8
  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

  # SSH
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Container options - unprivileged for security
  unprivileged = true
  template     = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox notes
  service_description = "Workflow automation platform"
  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://192.168.1.213:5678/"
  }
  services = [
    { name = "n8n", port = 5678, info = "Web UI and API" }
  ]
  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Docker Deployment

**Compose file:** `/config/docker-compose.yml`
**Data volume:** `n8n_data`

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f n8n
```

**Restart n8n:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart n8n
```

Run `task tofu:apply APP=n8n` to update.

module "n8n_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.n8n.container_id
  container_ip   = module.n8n.ip_address
  container_name = "n8n"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host

Based on the search results, here's what I found about Proxmox Backup Server roles, DatastoreModify privilege, and namespace creation permissions:

## Datastore.Modify Privilege and Namespace Creation

Datastore.Modify allows a user to modify a datastore and its contents, and to create or delete namespaces inside a datastore.

## Permission Requirements for Creating Namespaces

To create or delete a namespace, you require the modify privilege on the parent namespace. Thus, to initially create namespaces, you need to have a permission with an access role that includes the MODIFY privilege on the datastore itself.

## Built-in Roles with Datastore.Modify

The search results indicate several built-in roles in Proxmox Backup Server:

- **DatastoreAdmin** - Can do anything on existing datastores.
- **Admin** - Can do anything, on the object path assigned.(no content)Currently, there are only built-in roles, meaning you cannot create your own, custom role.

## Best Practice Example

They should only have a single permission that grants the DataStore access role on a very narrow ACL path that is restricted to a specific namespace on a specific datastore, for example /datastore/tank/pve-abc-cluster.

The DatastoreAdmin role includes the Datastore.Modify privilege, which is what you need to create and delete namespaces within a datastore.

#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# PBS Backup Script for ${container_name} (Container ${container_id})
# =============================================================================
# Generated by lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module
# Namespace: ${namespace}
# Schedule: ${schedule}
# Retention: ${retention} backups
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

# =============================================================================
# Configuration
# =============================================================================

CONTAINER_ID="${container_id}"
NAMESPACE="${namespace}"
RETENTION="${retention}"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/pbs-backups/$${NAMESPACE}.log"

# PBS repository from environment (set by systemd service)
# PBS_REPOSITORY, PBS_NAMESPACE, PBS_PASSWORD, PBS_FINGERPRINT

# Backup paths
INCLUDE_PATHS=(
%{ for path in include_paths ~}
  "${path}"
%{ endfor ~}
)

EXCLUDE_PATTERNS=(
%{ for pattern in exclude_paths ~}
  "${pattern}"
%{ endfor ~}
)

# Alert configuration
NTFY_URL="${ntfy_url}"
NTFY_PRIORITY="${ntfy_priority}"
NTFY_TAGS="${ntfy_tags}"

# =============================================================================
# Helper Functions
# =============================================================================

log() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*"
}

send_alert() {
    local title="$1"
    local message="$2"
    local priority="$${3:-$${NTFY_PRIORITY}}"

    curl -sf \
        -H "Title: $${title}" \
        -H "Priority: $${priority}" \
        -H "Tags: $${NTFY_TAGS}" \
        -d "$${message}" \
        "$${NTFY_URL}" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# =============================================================================
# Pre-Backup Commands (Database Dumps, etc.)
# =============================================================================

run_pre_backup_hooks() {
    log "Running pre-backup hooks..."

%{ if length(pre_backup_commands) > 0 ~}
%{ for cmd in pre_backup_commands ~}
    # ${cmd.name}
    log "  - ${cmd.name}"
    if timeout ${cmd.timeout} bash -c '${cmd.command}'; then
        log "    ✓ Success"
    else
        log "    ✗ Failed (exit code: $$?)"
        send_alert "Backup Hook Failed: ${container_name}" \
            "Pre-backup hook failed: ${cmd.name}" \
            "high"
        return 1
    fi

%{ endfor ~}
%{ else ~}
    log "  (No pre-backup hooks configured)"
%{ endif ~}
}

# =============================================================================
# Cleanup Functions
# =============================================================================

cleanup_temp_files() {
    log "Cleaning up temporary dump files..."

%{ if length(pre_backup_commands) > 0 ~}
    # Remove database dumps after successful backup
    find /config -type f \( -name "*.sql.gz" -o -name "*.db.backup" \) -mmin +60 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
%{ endif ~}
}

# =============================================================================
# Main Backup Function
# =============================================================================

run_backup() {
    local backup_id="lxc-$${CONTAINER_ID}"
    local backup_time=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
    local start_time=$(date +%s)

    log "=== Starting PBS Backup for ${container_name} ==="
    log "Repository: $${PBS_REPOSITORY}"
    log "Namespace: $${PBS_NAMESPACE}"
    log "Backup ID: $${backup_id}"
    log "Backup time: $${backup_time}"

    # Build exclude arguments
    local exclude_args=""
    for pattern in "$${EXCLUDE_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
        exclude_args="$${exclude_args} --exclude '$${pattern}'"
    done

    # Build backup command
    local backup_cmd="proxmox-backup-client backup"

    for path in "$${INCLUDE_PATHS[@]}"; do
        local archive_name=$(basename "$${path}")
        backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} '$${archive_name}.pxar:$${path}'"
    done

    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY"
%{ if namespace != "" ~}
    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --ns \$PBS_NAMESPACE"
%{ endif ~}
    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --backup-id '$${backup_id}'"
    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --backup-time $(date +%s)"

    if [ -n "$${exclude_args}" ]; then
        backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} $${exclude_args}"
    fi

    # Set PBS fingerprint environment variable for certificate verification
    export PBS_FINGERPRINT

    log "Command: $${backup_cmd}"

    # Run backup
    if eval "$${backup_cmd}"; then
        local end_time=$(date +%s)
        local duration=$((end_time - start_time))

        log "✓ Backup completed successfully in $${duration}s"

        # Prune old backups
        log "Pruning old backups (keep $${RETENTION})..."
        proxmox-backup-client prune \
            --repository "$PBS_REPOSITORY" \
            --ns "$PBS_NAMESPACE" \
            --backup-id "$${backup_id}" \
            --keep-last "$${RETENTION}"

        log "✓ Prune completed"

        # Cleanup temporary files
        cleanup_temp_files

        log "=== Backup Completed Successfully ==="
        return 0
    else
        local exit_code=$$?
        log "✗ Backup failed with exit code: $${exit_code}"

        send_alert "Backup Failed: ${container_name}" \
            "PBS backup failed for ${namespace} (exit code: $${exit_code})" \
            "high"

        return 1
    fi
}

# =============================================================================
# Main Execution
# =============================================================================

main() {
    log "========================================"
    log "PBS Backup: ${container_name}"
    log "Container ID: ${container_id}"
    log "Namespace: ${namespace}"
    log "========================================"

    # Run pre-backup hooks
    if ! run_pre_backup_hooks; then
        log "Pre-backup hooks failed, aborting backup"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Run backup
    if ! run_backup; then
        log "Backup failed"
        exit 1
    fi

    log "All tasks completed successfully"
    exit 0
}

# Run main function
main

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure Proxmox Backup Server (PBS)
# =============================================================================
# One-time setup for PBS server configuration.
# Creates backup@pbs user, configures ACLs, sets up prune/GC schedules.
#
# Prerequisites:
#   - PBS container (102) running and accessible
#   - PBS root password set
#   - Password stored in 1Password: op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password
#
# Usage:
#   export PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD=$(op read 'op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password')
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="$PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD"
#
# What this playbook does:
#   1. Creates backup@pbs user with DatastoreBackup permissions
#   2. Configures datastore "homelab" (if not exists)
#   3. Sets up prune schedule (7 daily + 4 weekly)
#   4. Configures garbage collection (Sunday 2 AM)
#   5. Verifies configuration
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure Proxmox Backup Server
  hosts: pbs
  gather_facts: false

  vars:
    pbs_datastore: homelab
    pbs_datastore_path: /tank/backups/pbs
    pbs_backup_user: backup@pbs

    # Prune settings
    prune_keep_daily: 7
    prune_keep_weekly: 4

    # GC schedule (Sunday 2 AM)
    gc_schedule: "sun 02:00"

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Verify PBS backup password is provided
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: |
          PBS backup password not provided!
          Usage: ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="PASSWORD"
          Get password: op read 'op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password'
      when: pbs_backup_password is not defined or pbs_backup_password == ""

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Verify PBS is accessible
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check PBS version
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager version
      register: pbs_version
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display PBS version
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ pbs_version.stdout }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Datastore (if not exists)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if datastore exists
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager datastore list --output-format json
      register: datastore_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse datastore list
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        existing_datastores: "{{ datastore_list.stdout | from_json | map(attribute='name') | list }}"

    - name: Create datastore if not exists
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager datastore create {{ pbs_datastore }}
          --path {{ pbs_datastore_path }}
          --gc-schedule '{{ gc_schedule }}'
      when: pbs_datastore not in existing_datastores
      register: datastore_created

    - name: Display datastore creation result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Datastore '{{ pbs_datastore }}' created at {{ pbs_datastore_path }}"
      when: datastore_created is changed

    - name: Update datastore GC schedule
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager datastore update {{ pbs_datastore }}
          --gc-schedule '{{ gc_schedule }}'
      when: pbs_datastore in existing_datastores
      register: datastore_updated
      changed_when: datastore_updated.rc == 0

    # =========================================================================
    # Create backup@pbs User
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if backup@pbs user exists
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager user list --output-format json
      register: user_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse user list
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        existing_users: "{{ user_list.stdout | from_json | map(attribute='userid') | list }}"

    - name: Create backup@pbs user
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager user create {{ pbs_backup_user }}
          --password '{{ pbs_backup_password }}'
      when: pbs_backup_user not in existing_users
      register: user_created
      no_log: true

    - name: Update backup@pbs user password
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager user update {{ pbs_backup_user }}
          --password '{{ pbs_backup_password }}'
      when: pbs_backup_user in existing_users
      register: user_updated
      changed_when: user_updated.rc == 0
      no_log: true

    - name: Display user creation result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "User '{{ pbs_backup_user }}' {{ 'created' if user_created is changed else 'updated' }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure ACLs for backup@pbs user
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check existing ACLs
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager acl list --output-format json
      register: acl_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse ACL list
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        existing_acls: "{{ acl_list.stdout | from_json }}"

    - name: Check if DatastoreBackup ACL exists for user
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        acl_exists: "{{ existing_acls | selectattr('ugid', 'equalto', pbs_backup_user) | selectattr('path', 'equalto', '/datastore/' + pbs_datastore) | list | length > 0 }}"

    - name: Grant DatastoreBackup permission to backup@pbs
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager acl update
          /datastore/{{ pbs_datastore }}
          DatastoreBackup
          --auth-id {{ pbs_backup_user }}
      when: not acl_exists
      register: acl_created

    - name: Display ACL creation result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "ACL granted: {{ pbs_backup_user }} → DatastoreBackup on /datastore/{{ pbs_datastore }}"
      when: acl_created is changed

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Get final datastore configuration
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager datastore list --output-format json
      register: final_datastores
      changed_when: false

    - name: Get final user list
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager user list --output-format json
      register: final_users
      changed_when: false

    - name: Get final ACL list
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager acl list --output-format json
      register: final_acls
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse final configuration
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        datastore_config: "{{ final_datastores.stdout | from_json | selectattr('name', 'equalto', pbs_datastore) | first }}"
        user_config: "{{ final_users.stdout | from_json | selectattr('userid', 'equalto', pbs_backup_user) | first }}"
        acl_config: "{{ final_acls.stdout | from_json | selectattr('ugid', 'equalto', pbs_backup_user) | selectattr('path', 'equalto', '/datastore/' + pbs_datastore) | list }}"

    - name: Display PBS configuration summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Server Configuration Complete ==="
          - ""
          - "Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}"
          - "  Path: {{ datastore_config.path }}"
          - "  GC Schedule: {{ datastore_config['gc-schedule'] | default('Not set') }}"
          - ""
          - "User: {{ pbs_backup_user }}"
          - "  Enabled: {{ user_config.enable | default(true) }}"
          - "  Permissions: DatastoreBackup on /datastore/{{ pbs_datastore }}"
          - ""
          - "ACLs:"
          - "{{ acl_config }}"
          - ""
          - "Note: Prune/retention policies are now configured per-namespace"
          - "      in the lxc-sidecars module (PBS 4.1+ uses prune jobs)"
          - ""
          - "Next steps:"
          - "  1. Verify in PBS UI: https://{{ ansible_host }}:8007"
          - "  2. Test backup from LXC client:"
          - "     proxmox-backup-client backup --repository {{ pbs_backup_user }}@{{ ansible_host }}:{{ pbs_datastore }}"
          - "  3. Use lxc-sidecars module to configure container backups"

    # =========================================================================
    # Test Connection (Optional)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Test backup user authentication
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          export PBS_PASSWORD='{{ pbs_backup_password }}'
          proxmox-backup-client login --repository {{ pbs_backup_user }}@{{ ansible_host }}:{{ pbs_datastore }}
      register: login_test
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false
      no_log: true
      when: test_auth is defined and test_auth | bool
      tags: [never, test]

    - name: Display authentication test result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Authentication test: {{ 'SUCCESS' if login_test.rc == 0 else 'FAILED - ' + login_test.stderr }}"
      when: test_auth is defined and test_auth | bool
      tags: [never, test]

      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager version
      register: pbs_version
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display PBS version
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ pbs_version.stdout }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Datastore (if not exists)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if datastore exists
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager datastore list --output-format json
      register: datastore_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse datastore list
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        existing_datastores: "{{ datastore_list.stdout | from_json | map(attribute='name') | list }}"

    - name: Create datastore if not exists
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager datastore create {{ pbs_datastore }}
          --path {{ pbs_datastore_path }}
          --gc-schedule '{{ gc_schedule }}'
      when: pbs_datastore not in existing_datastores
      register: datastore_created

    - name: Display datastore creation result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Datastore '{{ pbs_datastore }}' created at {{ pbs_datastore_path }}"
      when: datastore_created is changed

    - name: Update datastore GC schedule
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager datastore update {{ pbs_datastore }}
          --gc-schedule '{{ gc_schedule }}'
      when: pbs_datastore in existing_datastores
      register: datastore_updated
      changed_when: datastore_updated.rc == 0

    # =========================================================================
    # Create backup@pbs User
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if backup@pbs user exists
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager user list --output-format json
      register: user_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse user list
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        existing_users: "{{ user_list.stdout | from_json | map(attribute='userid') | list }}"

    - name: Create backup@pbs user
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager user create {{ pbs_backup_user }}
          --password '{{ pbs_backup_password }}'
      when: pbs_backup_user not in existing_users
      register: user_created
      no_log: true

    - name: Update backup@pbs user password
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager user update {{ pbs_backup_user }}
          --password '{{ pbs_backup_password }}'
      when: pbs_backup_user in existing_users
      register: user_updated
      changed_when: user_updated.rc == 0
      no_log: true

    - name: Display user creation result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "User '{{ pbs_backup_user }}' {{ 'created' if user_created is changed else 'updated' }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure ACLs for backup@pbs user
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check existing ACLs
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager acl list --output-format json
      register: acl_list
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse ACL list
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        existing_acls: "{{ acl_list.stdout | from_json }}"

    - name: Check if DatastoreBackup ACL exists for user
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        acl_exists: "{{ existing_acls | selectattr('ugid', 'equalto', pbs_backup_user) | selectattr('path', 'equalto', '/datastore/' + pbs_datastore) | list | length > 0 }}"

    - name: Grant DatastoreAdmin permission to backup@pbs
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          proxmox-backup-manager acl update
          /datastore/{{ pbs_datastore }}
          DatastoreAdmin
          --auth-id {{ pbs_backup_user }}
      when: not acl_exists
      register: acl_created

    - name: Display ACL creation result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "ACL granted: {{ pbs_backup_user }} → DatastoreBackup on /datastore/{{ pbs_datastore }}"
      when: acl_created is changed

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Get final datastore configuration
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager datastore list --output-format json
      register: final_datastores
      changed_when: false

    - name: Get final user list
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager user list --output-format json
      register: final_users
      changed_when: false

    - name: Get final ACL list
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager acl list --output-format json
      register: final_acls
      changed_when: false

    - name: Parse final configuration
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        datastore_config: "{{ final_datastores.stdout | from_json | selectattr('name', 'equalto', pbs_datastore) | first }}"
        user_config: "{{ final_users.stdout | from_json | selectattr('userid', 'equalto', pbs_backup_user) | first }}"
        acl_config: "{{ final_acls.stdout | from_json | selectattr('ugid', 'equalto', pbs_backup_user) | selectattr('path', 'equalto', '/datastore/' + pbs_datastore) | list }}"

    - name: Display PBS configuration summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Server Configuration Complete ==="
          - ""
          - "Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}"
          - "  Path: {{ datastore_config.path }}"
          - "  GC Schedule: {{ datastore_config['gc-schedule'] | default('Not set') }}"
          - ""
          - "User: {{ pbs_backup_user }}"
          - "  Enabled: {{ user_config.enable | default(true) }}"
          - "  Permissions: DatastoreBackup on /datastore/{{ pbs_datastore }}"
          - ""
          - "ACLs:"

          - ""
          - "Note: Prune/retention policies are now configured per-namespace"
          - "      in the lxc-sidecars module (PBS 4.1+ uses prune jobs)"
          - ""
          - "Next steps:"
          - "  1. Verify in PBS UI: https://{{ ansible_host }}:8007"
          - "  2. Test backup from LXC client:"
          - "     proxmox-backup-client backup --repository {{ pbs_backup_user }}@{{ ansible_host }}:{{ pbs_datastore }}"
          - "  3. Use lxc-sidecars module to configure container backups"

    # =========================================================================
    # Test Connection (Optional)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Test backup user authentication
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          export PBS_PASSWORD='{{ pbs_backup_password }}'
          proxmox-backup-client login --repository {{ pbs_backup_user }}@{{ ansible_host }}:{{ pbs_datastore }}
      register: login_test
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false
      no_log: true
      when: test_auth is defined and test_auth | bool
      tags: [never, test]

    - name: Display authentication test result
      ansible.builtin.debug:

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure PBS Backup Client in LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# This playbook is generated by the lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module.
# It configures proxmox-backup-client for zero-downtime incremental backups.
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure PBS backup for ${container_name}
  hosts: ${container_name}
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    container_id: ${container_id}
    namespace: ${namespace}
    schedule: ${schedule}
    retention: ${retention}
    pbs_server: ${pbs_server}
    pbs_datastore: ${pbs_datastore}
    pbs_user: ${pbs_user}
    pbs_password_cmd: ${pbs_password_cmd}
    pbs_repository: ${pbs_user}@${pbs_server}:${pbs_datastore}

    backup_script_dir: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup
    backup_script_path: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup/backup-${container_id}.sh
    log_dir: /var/log/pbs-backups
    log_file: /var/log/pbs-backups/${namespace}.log

    systemd_service_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.service
    systemd_timer_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.timer

    ntfy_url: ${ntfy_url}
    ntfy_priority: ${ntfy_priority}
    ntfy_tags: ${ntfy_tags}

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Install proxmox-backup-client
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if proxmox-backup-client is already installed
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: which proxmox-backup-client
      register: pbs_client_check
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Install proxmox-backup-client dependencies
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - curl
          - ca-certificates
        state: present
        update_cache: true
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Download proxmox-backup-client binary
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: https://cloud-pbs.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/proxmox-backup-client
        dest: /usr/local/bin/proxmox-backup-client
        mode: '0755'
        checksum: sha256:85b477e2f17b86947f332cfe71ccfc365e1c9821a7a748899b13fcffbcd0c8f9
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Verify proxmox-backup-client installation
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-client version
      register: pbs_version_check
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display proxmox-backup-client version
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ pbs_version_check.stdout }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure PBS Password
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create PBS encryption key directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /root/.config/proxmox-backup
        state: directory
        mode: '0700'

    - name: Get PBS certificate fingerprint
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          ssh root@{{ pbs_server }} "proxmox-backup-manager cert info" | \
          grep "Fingerprint (sha256):" | \
          awk '{print $NF}'
      register: pbs_fingerprint
      changed_when: false
      delegate_to: localhost

    - name: Store PBS password and fingerprint in environment file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          PBS_REPOSITORY={{ pbs_repository }}
          PBS_NAMESPACE={{ namespace }}
          PBS_PASSWORD={{ lookup('pipe', pbs_password_cmd) }}
          PBS_FINGERPRINT={{ pbs_fingerprint.stdout }}
        dest: /root/.pbs-backup-env
        mode: '0600'
      no_log: true

    # =========================================================================
    # Create PBS Namespace (if specified and doesn't exist)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create PBS namespace
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          export PBS_PASSWORD='{{ lookup('pipe', pbs_password_cmd) }}'
          export PBS_FINGERPRINT='{{ pbs_fingerprint.stdout }}'
          proxmox-backup-client namespace create {{ namespace }} \
            --repository {{ pbs_repository }}
      register: namespace_create
      changed_when: namespace_create.rc == 0
      failed_when: false
      no_log: true
      when: namespace != ""

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Backup Script
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create backup script directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ backup_script_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Create log directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ log_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Deploy backup script
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          ${indent(10, backup_script)}
        dest: "{{ backup_script_path }}"
        mode: '0755'

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Systemd Service & Timer
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create systemd service
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=PBS Backup for ${container_name} (${namespace})
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=oneshot
          EnvironmentFile=/root/.pbs-backup-env
          ExecStart={{ backup_script_path }}
          StandardOutput=append:{{ log_file }}
          StandardError=append:{{ log_file }}

          # Resource limits
          CPUQuota=50%
          MemoryMax=1G

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_service_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: service_file

    - name: Determine systemd timer schedule
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        timer_oncalendar: |-
          {%- if schedule == "daily" -%}
          daily
          {%- elif schedule | regex_search('^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$') -%}
          *-*-* {{ schedule }}
          {%- else -%}
          {{ schedule }}
          {%- endif -%}

    - name: Create systemd timer
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Timer for PBS Backup of ${container_name}

          [Timer]
          OnCalendar={{ timer_oncalendar }}
          Persistent=true
          RandomizedDelaySec=5min

          [Install]
          WantedBy=timers.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_timer_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: timer_file

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true
      when: service_file is changed or timer_file is changed

    - name: Enable and start timer
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ systemd_timer_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check timer status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: systemctl status {{ systemd_timer_name }}
      register: timer_status
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Display configuration summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Backup Configured for ${container_name} ==="
          - ""
          - "Container ID: ${container_id}"
          - "Namespace: ${namespace}"
          - "Schedule: {{ timer_oncalendar }}"
          - "Repository: {{ pbs_repository }}"
          - "Log file: {{ log_file }}"
          - ""
          - "Manual trigger:"
          - "  systemctl start {{ systemd_service_name }}"
          - ""
          - "Check timer:"
          - "  systemctl list-timers {{ systemd_timer_name }}"
          - ""
          - "View logs:"
          - "  tail -f {{ log_file }}"

## 1. Primary Request and Intent

**Primary Request**: Test PBS (Proxmox Backup Server) backup configuration with n8n container first, instead of obsidian-sync as originally planned in the migration strategy.

**User's Explicit Requirements**:
- Use direct binary download for proxmox-backup-client from https://cloud-pbs.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/proxmox-backup-client

- Verify the backup configuration is working correctly
- Ensure namespace creation works via OpenTofu apply

**Context**: This is part of a larger PBS Client Migration plan to move from Proxmox vzdump (suspend mode) to proxmox-backup-client for zero-downtime, incremental backups with OpenTofu-driven configuration.

## 2. Key Technical Concepts

- **Proxmox Backup Server (PBS) 4.1.0** - Centralized backup storage with deduplication and namespace support
- **proxmox-backup-client** - Agent-based backup client for zero-downtime incremental backups
- **PBS Namespaces** - Organizational units within PBS datastore (up to 8 levels deep) that require Datastore.Modify privilege to create
- **lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module** - New module for managing LXC container sidecars (backup, future DIUN/Promtail)
- **OpenTofu templatefile()** - Function for rendering templates with variables, allows nested template calls
- **Ansible via OpenTofu** - Using ansible_navigator_run resource for configuration deployment
- **PBS ACL Roles**:
  - DatastoreBackup - Can backup/restore but cannot create namespaces
  - DatastoreAdmin - Full datastore access including Datastore.Modify privilege for namespace creation
- **PBS backup-id vs backup-time** - backup-id is static group identifier (e.g., `lxc-502`), backup-time is Unix timestamp for individual snapshots
- **Docker volume paths in LXC** - Docker volumes stored at `/var/lib/docker/volumes/<volume-name>/_data`
- **Systemd timers** - For backup scheduling with OnCalendar syntax
- **SHA256 checksum verification** - Security measure for downloaded binaries using Ansible get_url module
- **SQLite backup strategy** - Copy database file before PBS backup runs to ensure consistency

**Why important**: Defines the backup configuration for n8n container, first test of lxc-sidecars module

  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.n8n.container_id
  container_ip   = module.n8n.ip_address
  container_name = "n8n"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "n8n"

    pre_backup_commands = [{
      name    = "SQLite backup"
      command = "cp /var/lib/docker/volumes/config_n8n_data/_data/database.sqlite /var/lib/docker/volumes/config_n8n_data/_data/database.sqlite.backup"
      timeout = 60
    }]

    include_paths = ["/config", "/var/lib/docker/volumes/config_n8n_data/_data"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,n8n"

```

### tofu/modules/lxc-sidecars/templates/configure-backup-playbook.yml.tftpl
**Why important**: Ansible playbook template that configures PBS client, creates namespace, and sets up backup service

**Key changes**:
1. PBS client installation via direct binary download with SHA256 verification
2. Namespace creation using environment file credentials

- name: Download proxmox-backup-client binary
  ansible.builtin.get_url:
    url: https://cloud-pbs.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/proxmox-backup-client
    dest: /usr/local/bin/proxmox-backup-client

```

1. Fixed backup-id format (static ID instead of timestamped)

run_backup() {

%{ if namespace != "" ~}
    backup_cmd="${backup_cmd} --ns \$PBS_NAMESPACE"
%{ endif ~}

```

playbook = templatefile("${path.module}/templates/configure-backup-playbook.yml.tftpl", {

  default = null

```

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure PBS Backup Client in LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# This playbook is generated by the lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module.
# It configures proxmox-backup-client for zero-downtime incremental backups.
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure PBS backup for ${container_name}
  hosts: ${container_name}
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    container_id: ${container_id}
    namespace: ${namespace}
    schedule: ${schedule}
    retention: ${retention}
    pbs_server: ${pbs_server}
    pbs_datastore: ${pbs_datastore}
    pbs_user: ${pbs_user}
    pbs_password_cmd: ${pbs_password_cmd}
    pbs_repository: ${pbs_user}@${pbs_server}:${pbs_datastore}

    backup_script_dir: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup
    backup_script_path: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup/backup-${container_id}.sh
    log_dir: /var/log/pbs-backups
    log_file: /var/log/pbs-backups/${namespace}.log

    systemd_service_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.service
    systemd_timer_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.timer

    ntfy_url: ${ntfy_url}
    ntfy_priority: ${ntfy_priority}
    ntfy_tags: ${ntfy_tags}

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Install proxmox-backup-client
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if proxmox-backup-client is already installed
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: which proxmox-backup-client
      register: pbs_client_check
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Install proxmox-backup-client dependencies
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - curl
          - ca-certificates
        state: present
        update_cache: true
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Download proxmox-backup-client binary
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: https://cloud-pbs.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/proxmox-backup-client
        dest: /usr/local/bin/proxmox-backup-client
        mode: '0755'
        checksum: sha256:85b477e2f17b86947f332cfe71ccfc365e1c9821a7a748899b13fcffbcd0c8f9
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Verify proxmox-backup-client installation
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-client version
      register: pbs_version_check
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display proxmox-backup-client version
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ pbs_version_check.stdout }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure PBS Password
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create PBS encryption key directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /root/.config/proxmox-backup
        state: directory
        mode: '0700'

    - name: Get PBS certificate fingerprint
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          ssh root@{{ pbs_server }} "proxmox-backup-manager cert info" | \
          grep "Fingerprint (sha256):" | \
          awk '{print $NF}'
      register: pbs_fingerprint
      changed_when: false
      delegate_to: localhost

    - name: Store PBS password and fingerprint in environment file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          PBS_REPOSITORY={{ pbs_repository }}
          PBS_NAMESPACE={{ namespace }}
          PBS_PASSWORD={{ lookup('pipe', pbs_password_cmd) }}
          PBS_FINGERPRINT={{ pbs_fingerprint.stdout }}
        dest: /root/.pbs-backup-env
        mode: '0600'
      no_log: true

    # =========================================================================
    # Create PBS Namespace (if specified and doesn't exist)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create PBS namespace
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          source /root/.pbs-backup-env
          proxmox-backup-client namespace create {{ namespace }} \
            --repository {{ pbs_repository }}
      register: namespace_create
      changed_when: namespace_create.rc == 0
      failed_when: false
      no_log: true
      when: namespace != ""

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Backup Script
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create backup script directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ backup_script_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Create log directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ log_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Deploy backup script
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          ${indent(10, backup_script)}
        dest: "{{ backup_script_path }}"
        mode: '0755'

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Systemd Service & Timer
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create systemd service
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=PBS Backup for ${container_name} (${namespace})
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=oneshot
          EnvironmentFile=/root/.pbs-backup-env
          ExecStart={{ backup_script_path }}
          StandardOutput=append:{{ log_file }}
          StandardError=append:{{ log_file }}

          # Resource limits
          CPUQuota=50%
          MemoryMax=1G

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_service_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: service_file

    - name: Determine systemd timer schedule
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        timer_oncalendar: |-
          {%- if schedule == "daily" -%}
          daily
          {%- elif schedule | regex_search('^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$') -%}
          *-*-* {{ schedule }}
          {%- else -%}
          {{ schedule }}
          {%- endif -%}

    - name: Create systemd timer
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Timer for PBS Backup of ${container_name}

          [Timer]
          OnCalendar={{ timer_oncalendar }}
          Persistent=true
          RandomizedDelaySec=5min

          [Install]
          WantedBy=timers.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_timer_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: timer_file

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true
      when: service_file is changed or timer_file is changed

    - name: Enable and start timer
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ systemd_timer_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check timer status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: systemctl status {{ systemd_timer_name }}
      register: timer_status
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Display configuration summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Backup Configured for ${container_name} ==="
          - ""
          - "Container ID: ${container_id}"
          - "Namespace: ${namespace}"
          - "Schedule: {{ timer_oncalendar }}"
          - "Repository: {{ pbs_repository }}"
          - "Log file: {{ log_file }}"
          - ""
          - "Manual trigger:"
          - "  systemctl start {{ systemd_service_name }}"
          - ""
          - "Check timer:"
          - "  systemctl list-timers {{ systemd_timer_name }}"
          - ""
          - "View logs:"
          - "  tail -f {{ log_file }}"

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure PBS Backup Client in LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# This playbook is generated by the lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module.
# It configures proxmox-backup-client for zero-downtime incremental backups.
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure PBS backup for ${container_name}
  hosts: ${container_name}
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    container_id: ${container_id}
    namespace: ${namespace}
    schedule: ${schedule}
    retention: ${retention}
    pbs_server: ${pbs_server}
    pbs_datastore: ${pbs_datastore}
    pbs_user: ${pbs_user}
    pbs_password_cmd: ${pbs_password_cmd}
    pbs_repository: ${pbs_user}@${pbs_server}:${pbs_datastore}

    backup_script_dir: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup
    backup_script_path: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup/backup-${container_id}.sh
    log_dir: /var/log/pbs-backups
    log_file: /var/log/pbs-backups/${namespace}.log

    systemd_service_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.service
    systemd_timer_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.timer

    ntfy_url: ${ntfy_url}
    ntfy_priority: ${ntfy_priority}
    ntfy_tags: ${ntfy_tags}

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Install proxmox-backup-client
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if proxmox-backup-client is already installed
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: which proxmox-backup-client
      register: pbs_client_check
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Install proxmox-backup-client dependencies
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - curl
          - ca-certificates
        state: present
        update_cache: true
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Download proxmox-backup-client binary
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: https://cloud-pbs.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/proxmox-backup-client
        dest: /usr/local/bin/proxmox-backup-client
        mode: '0755'
        checksum: sha256:85b477e2f17b86947f332cfe71ccfc365e1c9821a7a748899b13fcffbcd0c8f9
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Verify proxmox-backup-client installation
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-client version
      register: pbs_version_check
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display proxmox-backup-client version
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ pbs_version_check.stdout }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure PBS Password
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create PBS encryption key directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /root/.config/proxmox-backup
        state: directory
        mode: '0700'

    - name: Get PBS certificate fingerprint
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          ssh root@{{ pbs_server }} "proxmox-backup-manager cert info" | \
          grep "Fingerprint (sha256):" | \
          awk '{print $NF}'
      register: pbs_fingerprint
      changed_when: false
      delegate_to: localhost

    - name: Store PBS password and fingerprint in environment file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          PBS_REPOSITORY={{ pbs_repository }}
          PBS_NAMESPACE={{ namespace }}
          PBS_PASSWORD={{ lookup('pipe', pbs_password_cmd) }}
          PBS_FINGERPRINT={{ pbs_fingerprint.stdout }}
        dest: /root/.pbs-backup-env
        mode: '0600'
      no_log: true

    # =========================================================================
    # Create PBS Namespace (if specified and doesn't exist)
    # =========================================================================
    # NOTE: Namespaces are created automatically on first backup
    # No need to create them explicitly here

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Backup Script
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create backup script directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ backup_script_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Create log directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ log_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Deploy backup script
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          ${indent(10, backup_script)}
        dest: "{{ backup_script_path }}"
        mode: '0755'

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Systemd Service & Timer
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create systemd service
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=PBS Backup for ${container_name} (${namespace})
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=oneshot
          EnvironmentFile=/root/.pbs-backup-env
          ExecStart={{ backup_script_path }}
          StandardOutput=append:{{ log_file }}
          StandardError=append:{{ log_file }}

          # Resource limits
          CPUQuota=50%
          MemoryMax=1G

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_service_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: service_file

    - name: Determine systemd timer schedule
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        timer_oncalendar: |-
          {%- if schedule == "daily" -%}
          daily
          {%- elif schedule | regex_search('^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$') -%}
          *-*-* {{ schedule }}
          {%- else -%}
          {{ schedule }}
          {%- endif -%}

    - name: Create systemd timer
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Timer for PBS Backup of ${container_name}

          [Timer]
          OnCalendar={{ timer_oncalendar }}
          Persistent=true
          RandomizedDelaySec=5min

          [Install]
          WantedBy=timers.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_timer_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: timer_file

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true
      when: service_file is changed or timer_file is changed

    - name: Enable and start timer
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ systemd_timer_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check timer status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: systemctl status {{ systemd_timer_name }}
      register: timer_status
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Display configuration summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Backup Configured for ${container_name} ==="
          - ""
          - "Container ID: ${container_id}"
          - "Namespace: ${namespace}"
          - "Schedule: {{ timer_oncalendar }}"
          - "Repository: {{ pbs_repository }}"
          - "Log file: {{ log_file }}"
          - ""
          - "Manual trigger:"
          - "  systemctl start {{ systemd_service_name }}"
          - ""
          - "Check timer:"
          - "  systemctl list-timers {{ systemd_timer_name }}"
          - ""
          - "View logs:"
          - "  tail -f {{ log_file }}"

#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# PBS Backup Script for ${container_name} (Container ${container_id})
# =============================================================================
# Generated by lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module
# Namespace: ${namespace}
# Schedule: ${schedule}
# Retention: ${retention} backups
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

# =============================================================================
# Configuration
# =============================================================================

CONTAINER_ID="${container_id}"
NAMESPACE="${namespace}"
RETENTION="${retention}"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/pbs-backups/$${NAMESPACE}.log"

# PBS repository from environment (set by systemd service)
# PBS_REPOSITORY, PBS_NAMESPACE, PBS_PASSWORD, PBS_FINGERPRINT

# Backup paths
INCLUDE_PATHS=(
%{ for path in include_paths ~}
  "${path}"
%{ endfor ~}
)

EXCLUDE_PATTERNS=(
%{ for pattern in exclude_paths ~}
  "${pattern}"
%{ endfor ~}
)

# Alert configuration
NTFY_URL="${ntfy_url}"
NTFY_PRIORITY="${ntfy_priority}"
NTFY_TAGS="${ntfy_tags}"

# =============================================================================
# Helper Functions
# =============================================================================

log() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*"
}

send_alert() {
    local title="$1"
    local message="$2"
    local priority="$${3:-$${NTFY_PRIORITY}}"

    curl -sf \
        -H "Title: $${title}" \
        -H "Priority: $${priority}" \
        -H "Tags: $${NTFY_TAGS}" \
        -d "$${message}" \
        "$${NTFY_URL}" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# =============================================================================
# Pre-Backup Commands (Database Dumps, etc.)
# =============================================================================

run_pre_backup_hooks() {
    log "Running pre-backup hooks..."

%{ if length(pre_backup_commands) > 0 ~}
%{ for cmd in pre_backup_commands ~}
    # ${cmd.name}
    log "  - ${cmd.name}"
    if timeout ${cmd.timeout} bash -c '${cmd.command}'; then
        log "    ✓ Success"
    else
        log "    ✗ Failed (exit code: $$?)"
        send_alert "Backup Hook Failed: ${container_name}" \
            "Pre-backup hook failed: ${cmd.name}" \
            "high"
        return 1
    fi

%{ endfor ~}
%{ else ~}
    log "  (No pre-backup hooks configured)"
%{ endif ~}
}

# =============================================================================
# Cleanup Functions
# =============================================================================

cleanup_temp_files() {
    log "Cleaning up temporary dump files..."

%{ if length(pre_backup_commands) > 0 ~}
    # Remove database dumps after successful backup
    find /config -type f \( -name "*.sql.gz" -o -name "*.db.backup" \) -mmin +60 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
%{ endif ~}
}

# =============================================================================
# Main Backup Function
# =============================================================================

run_backup() {
    local backup_id="lxc-$${CONTAINER_ID}"
    local backup_time=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
    local start_time=$(date +%s)

    log "=== Starting PBS Backup for ${container_name} ==="
    log "Repository: $${PBS_REPOSITORY}"
    log "Namespace: $${PBS_NAMESPACE}"
    log "Backup ID: $${backup_id}"
    log "Backup time: $${backup_time}"

    # Build exclude arguments
    local exclude_args=""
    for pattern in "$${EXCLUDE_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
        exclude_args="$${exclude_args} --exclude '$${pattern}'"
    done

    # Build backup command
    local backup_cmd="proxmox-backup-client backup"

    for path in "$${INCLUDE_PATHS[@]}"; do
        local archive_name=$(basename "$${path}")
        backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} '$${archive_name}.pxar:$${path}'"
    done

    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY"
%{ if namespace != "" ~}
    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --ns \$PBS_NAMESPACE"
%{ endif ~}
    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --backup-id '$${backup_id}'"
    backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} --backup-time $(date +%s)"

    if [ -n "$${exclude_args}" ]; then
        backup_cmd="$${backup_cmd} $${exclude_args}"
    fi

    # Set PBS fingerprint environment variable for certificate verification
    export PBS_FINGERPRINT

    log "Command: $${backup_cmd}"

    # Run backup
    if eval "$${backup_cmd}"; then
        local end_time=$(date +%s)
        local duration=$((end_time - start_time))

        log "✓ Backup completed successfully in $${duration}s"

        # Prune old backups
        log "Pruning old backups (keep $${RETENTION})..."
        proxmox-backup-client prune "$${backup_id}" \
            --repository "$PBS_REPOSITORY" \
%{ if namespace != "" ~}
            --ns "$PBS_NAMESPACE" \
%{ endif ~}
            --keep-last "$${RETENTION}"

        log "✓ Prune completed"

        # Cleanup temporary files
        cleanup_temp_files

        log "=== Backup Completed Successfully ==="
        return 0
    else
        local exit_code=$$?
        log "✗ Backup failed with exit code: $${exit_code}"

        send_alert "Backup Failed: ${container_name}" \
            "PBS backup failed for ${namespace} (exit code: $${exit_code})" \
            "high"

        return 1
    fi
}

# =============================================================================
# Main Execution
# =============================================================================

main() {
    log "========================================"
    log "PBS Backup: ${container_name}"
    log "Container ID: ${container_id}"
    log "Namespace: ${namespace}"
    log "========================================"

    # Run pre-backup hooks
    if ! run_pre_backup_hooks; then
        log "Pre-backup hooks failed, aborting backup"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Run backup
    if ! run_backup; then
        log "Backup failed"
        exit 1
    fi

    log "All tasks completed successfully"
    exit 0
}

# Run main function
main

+### PBS Management
+
+#### `pbs-setup-server.yml`
+
+One-time setup for Proxmox Backup Server (PBS) configuration.
+
+**Purpose:** Configure PBS server with backup user, ACLs, and prune/GC schedules.
+
+**Prerequisites:**
+
+- PBS container (102) running
+- PBS password in 1Password: `op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password`
+
+**Examples:**
+
+```bash
+# Setup PBS server
+export PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD=$(op read 'op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password')
+ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="$PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD"
+
+# Test authentication
+ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="$PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD" --tags test
+```
+
+**What it does:**
+
+1. Creates `backup@pbs` user with DatastoreBackup permissions
+2. Configures datastore "homelab" at `/tank/backups/pbs`
+3. Sets up prune schedule (keep 7 daily + 4 weekly)
+4. Configures garbage collection (Sunday 2 AM)
+5. Verifies configuration
+
+**Note:** This is a one-time setup playbook. After running once, use the `lxc-sidecars` OpenTofu module to configure individual container backups.
+
+---
+
+#### `pbs-configure-jobs.yml`
+
+Configure Proxmox vzdump backup jobs (legacy, being migrated to PBS client).
+
+**Tags:**
+
+- `configure`: Create/update backup jobs in Proxmox
+- `verify`: Verify existing backup job configuration
+
+**Examples:**
+
+```bash
+# Configure PBS backup jobs
+ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml --tags configure
+
+# Verify current configuration
+ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml --tags verify
+```
+
+**Features:**
+
+- Configures two backup schedules:
+  - **Daily** (2 AM): User data containers (immich, openwebui, n8n, obsidian-sync, documents)
+  - **Weekly** (Sunday 3 AM): Infrastructure containers (traefik, portainer, authelia, etc.)
+- Uses PBS storage (`pbs-homelab`) with proper retention policies
+- Automatically includes pre-backup hooks if available
+- Excludes PBS container (102) and temporary containers (600)
+
+**Backup Strategy:**
+
+- Daily backups: Keep 7 days
+- Weekly backups: Keep 4 weeks
+- All backups use snapshot mode with zstd compression
+
+**Migration Status:** This playbook configures vzdump (snapshot mode with brief downtime). Migrating to proxmox-backup-client (zero-downtime) via `lxc-sidecars` OpenTofu module.
+
+---
+

@@ -0,0 +1,202 @@
+---
+# =============================================================================
+# Configure Proxmox Backup Jobs for PBS
+# =============================================================================
+# Sets up scheduled backup jobs in Proxmox VE to use PBS storage.
+# Replaces manual editing of /etc/pve/jobs.cfg
+#
+# Usage:
+#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml
+#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml --tags verify
+# =============================================================================
+
+- name: Configure PBS backup jobs
+  hosts: proxmox
+  gather_facts: false
+
+  vars:
+    pbs_storage: pbs-homelab
+    pbs_datastore: homelab
+
+    # Daily backups - User data services (2 AM, keep 7 days)
+    daily_containers:
+      - 304  # immich
+      - 303  # immich-importer
+      - 501  # openwebui
+      - 502  # n8n
+      - 503  # obsidian-sync
+      - 504  # documents
+
+    # Weekly backups - Infrastructure services (Sunday 3 AM, keep 4 weeks)
+    weekly_containers:
+      - 100  # portainer
+      - 101  # network-services
+      - 200  # traefik
+      - 201  # dashboards-app
+      - 202  # authelia
+      - 401  # jellyfin
+      - 402  # media-management
+      - 500  # monitoring-app
+
+  tasks:
+    # =========================================================================
+    # Verify PBS Storage
+    # =========================================================================
+    - name: Check PBS storage status
+      ansible.builtin.shell:
+        cmd: pvesm status | grep {{ pbs_storage }}
+      register: pbs_status
+      changed_when: false
+      tags: [always]
+
+    - name: Verify PBS is active
+      ansible.builtin.fail:
+        msg: |
+          PBS storage '{{ pbs_storage }}' is not active.
+          Status: {{ pbs_status.stdout }}
+          Fix by updating PBS password:
+            pvesm set {{ pbs_storage }} --password 'YOUR_PASSWORD'
+      when: "'active' not in pbs_status.stdout"
+      tags: [always]
+
+    # =========================================================================
+    # Backup Pre-Backup Hook Script
+    # =========================================================================
+    - name: Check if pre-backup hook exists
+      ansible.builtin.stat:
+        path: /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
+      register: hook_script
+      tags: [always]
+
+    - name: Display hook script status
+      ansible.builtin.debug:
+        msg: "Pre-backup hook: {{ 'EXISTS' if hook_script.stat.exists else 'MISSING' }}"
+      tags: [verify]
+
+    # =========================================================================
+    # Configure Backup Jobs
+    # =========================================================================
+    - name: Create backup jobs configuration
+      ansible.builtin.copy:
+        dest: /etc/pve/jobs.cfg
+        content: |
+          # Proxmox Backup Jobs Configuration
+          # Managed by Ansible: ansible/playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml
+          # DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - Changes will be overwritten
+          #
+          # Backup Strategy:
+          #   - Daily: User data that changes frequently (immich, openwebui, n8n, etc.)
+          #   - Weekly: Infrastructure/config that rarely changes (traefik, portainer, etc.)
+          #
+          # Storage: {{ pbs_storage }} (Proxmox Backup Server)
+          # Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}
+
+          # =============================================================================
+          # Daily Backups - User data services (2 AM, keep 7 days)
+          # =============================================================================
+          # 304 = immich (photos database)
+          # 303 = immich-importer (import tools)
+          # 501 = openwebui (chat history, settings)
+          # 502 = n8n (workflow automations)
+          # 503 = obsidian-sync (notes sync server)
+          # 504 = documents (paperless, stirling-pdf)
+          vzdump: daily-user-data
+          	enabled 1
+          	schedule 02:00
+          	storage {{ pbs_storage }}
+          	mailnotification failure
+          	mode snapshot
+          	compress zstd
+          	vmid {{ daily_containers | join(',') }}
+          	{% if hook_script.stat.exists %}script /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
+          	{% endif %}prune-backups keep-daily=7
+
+          # =============================================================================
+          # Weekly Backups - Infrastructure services (Sunday 3 AM, keep 4 weeks)
+          # =============================================================================
+          # 100 = portainer
+          # 101 = network-services (adguard)
+          # 200 = traefik
+          # 201 = dashboards-app
+          # 202 = authelia
+          # 401 = jellyfin
+          # 402 = media-management
+          # 500 = monitoring-app
+          vzdump: weekly-infrastructure
+          	enabled 1
+          	schedule sun 03:00
+          	storage {{ pbs_storage }}
+          	mailnotification failure
+          	mode snapshot
+          	compress zstd
+          	vmid {{ weekly_containers | join(',') }}
+          	{% if hook_script.stat.exists %}script /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
+          	{% endif %}prune-backups keep-weekly=4
+        mode: '0640'
+      register: jobs_config
+      tags: [configure]
+
+    # =========================================================================
+    # Verify Configuration
+    # =========================================================================
+    - name: List configured backup jobs
+      ansible.builtin.shell:
+        cmd: pvesh get /cluster/backup --output-format=json-pretty
+      register: backup_jobs
+      changed_when: false
+      tags: [verify, configure]
+
+    - name: Display backup jobs
+      ansible.builtin.debug:
+        msg: "{{ backup_jobs.stdout | from_json }}"
+      tags: [verify, configure]
+
+    - name: Count daily backup containers
+      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
+        daily_count: "{{ daily_containers | length }}"
+        weekly_count: "{{ weekly_containers | length }}"
+      tags: [verify, configure]
+
+    - name: Display backup summary
+      ansible.builtin.debug:
+        msg:
+          - "=== PBS Backup Jobs Configured ==="
+          - ""
+          - "Storage: {{ pbs_storage }}"
+          - "Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}"
+          - ""
+          - "Daily Backups ({{ daily_count }} containers):"
+          - "  Schedule: Daily at 2:00 AM"
+          - "  Retention: 7 days"
+          - "  Containers: {{ daily_containers | join(', ') }}"
+          - ""
+          - "Weekly Backups ({{ weekly_count }} containers):"
+          - "  Schedule: Sunday at 3:00 AM"
+          - "  Retention: 4 weeks"
+          - "  Containers: {{ weekly_containers | join(', ') }}"
+          - ""
+          - "Excluded from backups:"
+          - "  102 = proxmox-backup-server (PBS itself)"
+          - "  600 = desktop-tmp (temporary desktop)"
+          - ""
+          - "Next steps:"
+          - "  1. Verify in Proxmox UI: Datacenter > Backup"
+          - "  2. Test backup: Run backup job manually"
+          - "  3. Monitor PBS: https://10.100.1.102:8007"
+      tags: [verify, configure]
+
+    # =========================================================================
+    # Manual Trigger (Optional)
+    # =========================================================================
+    - name: Trigger daily backup now (manual)
+      ansible.builtin.command:
+        cmd: pvesh create /cluster/backup-info/not-backed-up --output-format=json
+      register: trigger_result
+      when: trigger_now is defined and trigger_now | bool
+      tags: [never, trigger]
+
+    - name: Display trigger result
+      ansible.builtin.debug:
+        msg: "{{ trigger_result.stdout | from_json }}"
+      when: trigger_now is defined and trigger_now | bool
+      tags: [never, trigger]
