+++ b/ansible/playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,239 @@
+---
+# =============================================================================
+# Configure Proxmox Backup Server (PBS)
+# =============================================================================
+# One-time setup for PBS server configuration.
+# Creates backup@pbs user, configures ACLs, sets up prune/GC schedules.
+#
+# Prerequisites:
+#   - PBS container (102) running and accessible
+#   - PBS root password set
+#   - Password stored in 1Password: op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password
+#
+# Usage:
+#   export PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD=$(op read 'op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password')
+#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="$PBS_BACKUP_PASSWORD"
+#
+# What this playbook does:
+#   1. Creates backup@pbs user with DatastoreBackup permissions
+#   2. Configures datastore "homelab" (if not exists)
+#   3. Sets up prune schedule (7 daily + 4 weekly)
+#   4. Configures garbage collection (Sunday 2 AM)
+#   5. Verifies configuration
+# =============================================================================
+
+- name: Configure Proxmox Backup Server
+  hosts: pbs
+  gather_facts: false
+
+  vars:
+    pbs_datastore: homelab
+    pbs_datastore_path: /tank/backups/pbs
+    pbs_backup_user: backup@pbs
+
+    # Prune settings
+    prune_keep_daily: 7
+    prune_keep_weekly: 4
+
+    # GC schedule (Sunday 2 AM)
+    gc_schedule: "sun 02:00"
+
+  pre_tasks:
+    - name: Verify PBS backup password is provided
+      ansible.builtin.fail:
+        msg: |
+          PBS backup password not provided!
+          Usage: ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-setup-server.yml -e pbs_backup_password="PASSWORD"
+          Get password: op read 'op://homelab/pbs-backup-user/password'
+      when: pbs_backup_password is not defined or pbs_backup_password == ""
+
+  tasks:
+    # =========================================================================
+    # Verify PBS is accessible
+    # =========================================================================
+    - name: Check PBS version
+      ansible.builtin.command:
+        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager version
+      register: pbs_version
+      changed_when: false
+
+    - name: Display PBS version
+      ansible.builtin.debug:
+        msg: "{{ pbs_version.stdout }}"
+
+    # =========================================================================
+    # Create Datastore (if not exists)
+    # =========================================================================
+    - name: Check if datastore exists
+      ansible.builtin.command:
+        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager datastore list --output-format json
+      register: datastore_list
+      changed_when: false
+
+    - name: Parse datastore list
+      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
+        existing_datastores: "{{ datastore_list.stdout | from_json | map(attribute='name') | list }}"
+
+    - name: Create datastore if not exists
+      ansible.builtin.command:
+        cmd: >
+          proxmox-backup-manager datastore create {{ pbs_datastore }}
+          --path {{ pbs_datastore_path }}
+          --gc-schedule '{{ gc_schedule }}'
+      when: pbs_datastore not in existing_datastores
+      register: datastore_created
+
+    - name: Display datastore creation result
+      ansible.builtin.debug:
+        msg: "Datastore '{{ pbs_datastore }}' created at {{ pbs_datastore_path }}"
+      when: datastore_created is changed
+
+    - name: Update datastore GC schedule
+      ansible.builtin.command:
+        cmd: >
+          proxmox-backup-manager datastore update {{ pbs_datastore }}
+          --gc-schedule '{{ gc_schedule }}'
+      when: pbs_datastore in existing_datastores
+      register: datastore_updated
+      changed_when: datastore_updated.rc == 0
+
+    # =========================================================================
+    # Create backup@pbs User
+    # =========================================================================
+    - name: Check if backup@pbs user exists
+      ansible.builtin.command:
+        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager user list --output-format json
+      register: user_list
+      changed_when: false
+
+    - name: Parse user list
+      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
+        existing_users: "{{ user_list.stdout | from_json | map(attribute='userid') | list }}"
+
+    - name: Create backup@pbs user
+      ansible.builtin.command:
+        cmd: >
+          proxmox-backup-manager user create {{ pbs_backup_user }}
+          --password '{{ pbs_backup_password }}'
+      when: pbs_backup_user not in existing_users
+      register: user_created
+      no_log: true
+
+    - name: Update backup@pbs user password
+      ansible.builtin.command:
+        cmd: >
+          proxmox-backup-manager user update {{ pbs_backup_user }}
+          --password '{{ pbs_backup_password }}'
+      when: pbs_backup_user in existing_users
+      register: user_updated
+      changed_when: user_updated.rc == 0
+      no_log: true
+
+    - name: Display user creation result
+      ansible.builtin.debug:
+        msg: "User '{{ pbs_backup_user }}' {{ 'created' if user_created is changed else 'updated' }}"
+
+    # =========================================================================
+    # Configure ACLs for backup@pbs user
+    # =========================================================================
+    - name: Check existing ACLs
+      ansible.builtin.command:
+        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager acl list --output-format json
+      register: acl_list
+      changed_when: false
+
+    - name: Parse ACL list
+      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
+        existing_acls: "{{ acl_list.stdout | from_json }}"
+
+    - name: Check if DatastoreBackup ACL exists for user
+      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
+        acl_exists: "{{ existing_acls | selectattr('ugid', 'equalto', pbs_backup_user) | selectattr('path', 'equalto', '/datastore/' + pbs_datastore) | list | length > 0 }}"
+
+    - name: Grant DatastoreAdmin permission to backup@pbs
+      ansible.builtin.command:
+        cmd: >
+          proxmox-backup-manager acl update
+          /datastore/{{ pbs_datastore }}
+          DatastoreAdmin
+          --auth-id {{ pbs_backup_user }}
+      when: not acl_exists
+      register: acl_created
+
+    - name: Display ACL creation result
+      ansible.builtin.debug:
+        msg: "ACL granted: {{ pbs_backup_user }} → DatastoreAdmin on /datastore/{{ pbs_datastore }}"
+      when: acl_created is changed
+
+    # =========================================================================
+    # Verify Configuration
+    # =========================================================================
+    - name: Get final datastore configuration
+      ansible.builtin.command:
+        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager datastore list --output-format json
+      register: final_datastores
+      changed_when: false
+
+    - name: Get final user list
+      ansible.builtin.command:
+        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager user list --output-format json
+      register: final_users
+      changed_when: false
+
+    - name: Get final ACL list
+      ansible.builtin.command:
+        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager acl list --output-format json
+      register: final_acls
+      changed_when: false
+
+    - name: Parse final configuration
+      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
+        datastore_config: "{{ final_datastores.stdout | from_json | selectattr('name', 'equalto', pbs_datastore) | first }}"
+        user_config: "{{ final_users.stdout | from_json | selectattr('userid', 'equalto', pbs_backup_user) | first }}"
+        acl_config: "{{ final_acls.stdout | from_json | selectattr('ugid', 'equalto', pbs_backup_user) | selectattr('path', 'equalto', '/datastore/' + pbs_datastore) | list }}"
+
+    - name: Display PBS configuration summary
+      ansible.builtin.debug:
+        msg:
+          - "=== PBS Server Configuration Complete ==="
+          - ""
+          - "Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}"
+          - "  Path: {{ datastore_config.path }}"
+          - "  GC Schedule: {{ datastore_config['gc-schedule'] | default('Not set') }}"
+          - ""
+          - "User: {{ pbs_backup_user }}"
+          - "  Enabled: {{ user_config.enable | default(true) }}"
+          - "  Permissions: DatastoreBackup on /datastore/{{ pbs_datastore }}"
+          - ""
+          - "ACLs:"
+          - "{{ acl_config }}"
+          - ""
+          - "Note: Prune/retention policies are now configured per-namespace"
+          - "      in the lxc-sidecars module (PBS 4.1+ uses prune jobs)"
+          - ""
+          - "Next steps:"
+          - "  1. Verify in PBS UI: https://{{ ansible_host }}:8007"
+          - "  2. Test backup from LXC client:"
+          - "     proxmox-backup-client backup --repository {{ pbs_backup_user }}@{{ ansible_host }}:{{ pbs_datastore }}"
+          - "  3. Use lxc-sidecars module to configure container backups"
+

+#   4. Configures garbage collection (Sunday 2 AM)
+#   5. Verifies configuration

+

+    pbs_backup_user: backup@pbs
+
+    # Prune settings
+    prune_keep_daily: 7
+    prune_keep_weekly: 4
+
+    # GC schedule (Sunday 2 AM)
+    gc_schedule: "sun 02:00"
+

+    - name: Check PBS version

+      changed_when: false
+
+    - name: Display PBS version
+      ansible.builtin.debug:
+        msg: "{{ pbs_version.stdout }}"
+
+    # =========================================================================
+    # Create Datastore (if not exists)
+    # =========================================================================
+    - name: Check if datastore exists
+      ansible.builtin.command:
+        cmd: proxmox-backup-manager datastore list --output-format json
+      register: datastore_list

+      ansible.builtin.set_fact:

+          --gc-schedule '{{ gc_schedule }}'

- **PBS Namespaces** - Organizational units within PBS datastore requiring Datastore.Modify privilege to create

- **PBS backup-id vs backup-time** - backup-id is static group identifier (e.g., `lxc-502`), backup-time is Unix timestamp for snapshots
- **Docker volume paths in LXC** - Docker volumes stored at `/var/lib/docker/volumes/<volume-name>/_data`

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate combined .env file with Immich + Edge credentials
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE: We generate a combined .env file here instead of using the docker-lxc
# module's portainer_edge_id/key because Immich needs additional env vars
# for database, uploads, etc. The module would overwrite these.

resource "local_sensitive_file" "immich_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Immich Configuration
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten
# https://immich.app/docs/install/environment-variables

# Paths - these match the LXC mount points from main.tf
UPLOAD_LOCATION=/photos
DB_DATA_LOCATION=/var/lib/postgresql/data

# Version - use 'release' for latest stable
IMMICH_VERSION=release

# Database credentials
DB_PASSWORD=qjIYvd2gOMh71CBpgA
DB_USERNAME=postgres
DB_DATABASE_NAME=immich

# Timezone
TZ=America/New_York

# OpenTelemetry - push metrics to monitoring stack
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://10.100.5.100:4318
OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=immich
IMMICH_TELEMETRY_INCLUDE=all

# Portainer Edge Agent credentials (from 1Password: portainer-edge-immich)
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${local.portainer_edge["immich"].edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${local.portainer_edge["immich"].edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 304
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 6
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 6144
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Immich Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "immich" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "immich-docker"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for mobile app)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.photos.immich}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.immich}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 2048

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Enable AMD GPU passthrough for ML acceleration and video transcoding
  enable_gpu = true

  # NOTE: We don't set portainer_edge_id/key here because this app generates
  # its own .env file that includes both Immich and Edge credentials.
  # Setting them here would cause the docker-lxc module to create a separate
  # .env that would overwrite our combined one.

  # Mount points for photos and cache
  # These are configured via SSH (null_resource.configure_mount_points) since
  # the API token doesn't have permission for bind mounts (requires root@pam)
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/photos"
      volume = "/tank/photos"
    },
    {
      slot   = 1
      path   = "/cache"
      volume = "/tank/cache/immich"
    }
  ]

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Immich"
  service_description = "Self-hosted photo and video management with ML features"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://photos.${var.domain_internal}"
    public   = "https://photos.${var.domain_public}"
    direct   = "http://192.168.1.222:2283"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Immich Web", port = 2283, info = "Photo management UI" },
    { name = "Immich Server", port = 2283, info = "API server" },
    { name = "Immich ML", port = 3003, info = "Machine learning service" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Cache" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Storage

**Photos:** `/photos` (mounted from `/tank/photos`)
**Cache:** `/cache` (mounted from `/tank/cache/immich`)
**Database:** Docker volumes (immich_pgdata)

## GPU Acceleration

AMD Radeon 890M passed through for ML acceleration:
- `/dev/dri/card0` - GPU device
- `/dev/dri/renderD128` - Render device

**Check GPU access:**
```bash
ls -la /dev/dri/
docker exec immich_machine_learning rocminfo
```

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose logs -f immich_server
```

**Restart all services:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

**Force reprocess ML jobs:**
```bash
docker exec -it immich_server npm run cli -- jobs run all
```

## Database Backup

Backup script runs pre-backup hook for Proxmox vzdump.
Manual backup:
```bash
cd /config && docker compose exec -T postgres pg_dumpall -U postgres > backup.sql
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=immich` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["photos", "immich", "media"]
}

# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "immich_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "photos"
  backend_url = "http://${module.immich.ip_address}:2283"

# Immich - Self-hosted photo and video management
# https://immich.app/docs/install/docker-compose
# Updated: 2025-12 based on official v1.123+ config

name: immich

services:
  immich-server:
    container_name: immich_server
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release}
    # Hardware transcoding: VAAPI for AMD GPU
    devices:
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    group_add:
      - video
    volumes:
      - ${UPLOAD_LOCATION}:/usr/src/app/upload
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
    env_file:
      - .env
    ports:
      - 2283:2283
    depends_on:
      - redis
      - database
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      disable: false

  immich-machine-learning:
    container_name: immich_machine_learning
    # Using CPU image since AMD Radeon 890M (gfx1150) needs ROCm 6.4.4+
    # Immich ROCm image only has 6.3.4
    # Change to :release-rocm if/when Immich updates ROCm version
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-machine-learning:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release}
    # Uncomment below and change image tag to :release-rocm when ROCm 6.4.4+ is available
    # devices:
    #   - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    #   - /dev/kfd:/dev/kfd
    # group_add:
    #   - video
    #   - render
    volumes:
      - model-cache:/cache
    env_file:
      - .env
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      disable: false

  redis:
    container_name: immich_redis
    image: docker.io/valkey/valkey:8-bookworm
    healthcheck:
      test: valkey-cli ping || exit 1
    restart: unless-stopped

  database:
    container_name: immich_postgres
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres:14-vectorchord0.4.3-pgvectors0.2.0
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USERNAME}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_DATABASE_NAME}
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: '--data-checksums'
    volumes:
      - ${DB_DATA_LOCATION}:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: >-
        pg_isready --dbname="$${POSTGRES_DB}" --username="$${POSTGRES_USER}" || exit
        1; Chksum="$$(psql --dbname="$${POSTGRES_DB}" --username="$${POSTGRES_USER}"
        --tuples-only --no-align --command='SELECT COALESCE(SUM(googlechecksum(googlechecksum(tableoid,
        entity_id))), 0) FROM entity WHERE NOT is_external')"; Prev="$$(cat
        /tmp/.immich_db_checksum 2>/dev/null || echo '')"; echo "$${Chksum}" >
        /tmp/.immich_db_checksum; test "$${Prev}" = '' -o "$${Prev}" = "$${Chksum}"
      interval: 5m
      start_interval: 30s
      start_period: 5m
    command:
      [
        'postgres',
        '-c',
        'shared_preload_libraries=vchord.so,vectors.so',
        '-c',
        'search_path="$$user", public, vectors',
        '-c',
        'logging_collector=on',
        '-c',
        'max_wal_size=2GB',
        '-c',
        'shared_buffers=512MB',
        '-c',
        'wal_compression=on',
      ]
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-immich
  portainer-edge-agent:
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

# =============================================================================
# OpenWebUI LXC - AI Chat Interface with Ollama
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 501
# IP: 192.168.1.221
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Features AMD GPU passthrough for Ollama LLM acceleration.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 501
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 12
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 24576
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OpenWebUI Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "openwebui" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "openwebui"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 2048

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged for security (with GPU passthrough)
  unprivileged = true
  enable_gpu   = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "OpenWebUI"
  service_description = "AI chat interface with Ollama backend (AMD GPU accelerated)"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://ai.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct   = "http://192.168.1.221:3000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "OpenWebUI", port = 3000, info = "AI chat interface" },
    { name = "Ollama", port = 11434, info = "LLM backend (ROCM GPU)" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## GPU Acceleration

AMD Radeon 890M passed through for Ollama LLM acceleration:
- `/dev/kfd`, `/dev/dri` devices
- ROCM backend

**Check GPU:**
```
docker exec ollama rocminfo
```

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f openwebui
cd /config && docker compose logs -f ollama
```

**List models:**
```
docker exec ollama ollama list
```

**Pull new model:**
```
docker exec ollama ollama pull llama3.2
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=openwebui` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["openwebui", "ai", "ollama", "llm"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "openwebui_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "openwebui"
  backend_url = "http://${module.openwebui.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal and public routes (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "ai.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "ai.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.openwebui]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.openwebui.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.openwebui.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.openwebui.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = module.openwebui_route.internal_url
    public   = module.openwebui_route.public_url
    direct   = "http://${module.openwebui.ip_address}:3000"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.openwebui_route.remote_config_path
}

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure PBS Backup Client in LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# This playbook is generated by the lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module.
# It configures proxmox-backup-client for zero-downtime incremental backups.
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure PBS backup for ${container_name}
  hosts: ${container_name}
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    container_id: ${container_id}
    namespace: ${namespace}
    schedule: ${schedule}
    retention: ${retention}
    pbs_server: ${pbs_server}
    pbs_datastore: ${pbs_datastore}
    pbs_user: ${pbs_user}
    pbs_password_cmd: ${pbs_password_cmd}
    pbs_repository: ${pbs_user}@${pbs_server}:${pbs_datastore}

    backup_script_dir: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup
    backup_script_path: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup/backup-${container_id}.sh
    log_dir: /var/log/pbs-backups
    log_file: /var/log/pbs-backups/${namespace}.log

    systemd_service_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.service
    systemd_timer_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.timer

    ntfy_url: ${ntfy_url}
    ntfy_priority: ${ntfy_priority}
    ntfy_tags: ${ntfy_tags}

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Install proxmox-backup-client
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if proxmox-backup-client is already installed
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: which proxmox-backup-client
      register: pbs_client_check
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Install proxmox-backup-client dependencies
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - curl
          - ca-certificates
        state: present
        update_cache: true
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Download proxmox-backup-client binary
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: https://cloud-pbs.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/proxmox-backup-client
        dest: /usr/local/bin/proxmox-backup-client
        mode: '0755'
        checksum: sha256:85b477e2f17b86947f332cfe71ccfc365e1c9821a7a748899b13fcffbcd0c8f9
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Verify proxmox-backup-client installation
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-client version
      register: pbs_version_check
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display proxmox-backup-client version
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ pbs_version_check.stdout }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure PBS Password
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create PBS encryption key directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /root/.config/proxmox-backup
        state: directory
        mode: '0700'

    - name: Get PBS certificate fingerprint
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          ssh root@{{ pbs_server }} "proxmox-backup-manager cert info" | \
          grep "Fingerprint (sha256):" | \
          awk '{print $NF}'
      register: pbs_fingerprint
      changed_when: false
      delegate_to: localhost

    - name: Store PBS password and fingerprint in environment file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          PBS_REPOSITORY={{ pbs_repository }}
          PBS_NAMESPACE={{ namespace }}
          PBS_PASSWORD={{ lookup('pipe', pbs_password_cmd) }}
          PBS_FINGERPRINT={{ pbs_fingerprint.stdout }}
        dest: /root/.pbs-backup-env
        mode: '0600'
      no_log: true

    # =========================================================================
    # Create PBS Namespace (if specified and doesn't exist)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create PBS namespace
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          set -a
          source /root/.pbs-backup-env
          set +a
          proxmox-backup-client namespace create {{ namespace }} --repository {{ pbs_repository }}
        executable: /bin/bash
      register: namespace_create
      changed_when: "'created namespace' in namespace_create.stdout or namespace_create.rc == 0"
      failed_when: false
      no_log: true
      when: namespace != ""

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Backup Script
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create backup script directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ backup_script_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Create log directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ log_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Deploy backup script
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          ${indent(10, backup_script)}
        dest: "{{ backup_script_path }}"
        mode: '0755'

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Systemd Service & Timer
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create systemd service
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=PBS Backup for ${container_name} (${namespace})
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=oneshot
          EnvironmentFile=/root/.pbs-backup-env
          ExecStart={{ backup_script_path }}
          StandardOutput=append:{{ log_file }}
          StandardError=append:{{ log_file }}

          # Resource limits
          CPUQuota=50%
          MemoryMax=1G

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_service_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: service_file

    - name: Determine systemd timer schedule
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        timer_oncalendar: |-
          {%- if schedule == "daily" -%}
          daily
          {%- elif schedule | regex_search('^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$') -%}
          *-*-* {{ schedule }}
          {%- else -%}
          {{ schedule }}
          {%- endif -%}

    - name: Create systemd timer
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Timer for PBS Backup of ${container_name}

          [Timer]
          OnCalendar={{ timer_oncalendar }}
          Persistent=true
          RandomizedDelaySec=5min

          [Install]
          WantedBy=timers.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_timer_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: timer_file

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true
      when: service_file is changed or timer_file is changed

    - name: Enable and start timer
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ systemd_timer_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check timer status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: systemctl status {{ systemd_timer_name }}
      register: timer_status
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Display configuration summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Backup Configured for ${container_name} ==="
          - ""
          - "Container ID: ${container_id}"
          - "Namespace: ${namespace}"
          - "Schedule: {{ timer_oncalendar }}"
          - "Repository: {{ pbs_repository }}"
          - "Log file: {{ log_file }}"

          - "Manual trigger:"

          - ""
          - "Check timer:"
          - "  systemctl list-timers {{ systemd_timer_name }}"
          - ""
          - "View logs:"
          - "  tail -f {{ log_file }}"

# =============================================================================
# Documents LXC - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 504
# IP: 10.100.5.104
#
# Document management stack:
# - Paperless-ngx: OCR, full-text search, auto-tagging, email consumption
# - Stirling-PDF: PDF manipulation (merge, split, compress, convert, etc.)
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Paperless Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "paperless" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "paperless"
}

locals {
  # Flatten paperless section fields into a map by label
  _paperless_section_fields = merge([
    for s in try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.section, []) : {
      for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  paperless = {
    admin_user     = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.username, "admin")
    admin_password = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.password, "")
    db_password    = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "db_password", "")
    secret_key     = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "secret_key", "")
  }
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "documents_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Documents Stack Environment
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Paperless-ngx
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${local.paperless.admin_user}
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.admin_password}
PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.db_password}
PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${local.paperless.secret_key}

# Portainer Edge Agent
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 504
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4  # OCR is CPU intensive
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192  # OCR needs memory
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64  # Documents can grow large
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documents Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "documents"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # NOTE: Do NOT pass portainer_edge_id/key here - we handle the combined .env file
  # ourselves (including both paperless secrets AND portainer credentials).
  # The module's portainer env feature only supports portainer-only env files.

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure .env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.documents_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Documents"
  service_description = "Document management with Paperless-ngx (OCR) and Stirling-PDF (utilities)"

  service_urls = {
    paperless_internal    = "https://docs.${var.domain_internal}"
    paperless_public      = "https://docs.${var.domain_public}"
    stirling_pdf_internal = "https://pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
    stirling_pdf_public   = "https://pdf.${var.domain_public}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Paperless-ngx", port = 8000, info = "Document management with OCR" },
    { name = "Stirling-PDF", port = 8080, info = "PDF manipulation tools" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Paperless database (internal)" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Paperless cache (internal)" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f paperless
cd /config && docker compose logs -f stirling-pdf
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart paperless
cd /config && docker compose restart stirling-pdf
```

**Import documents:**
Place files in `/config/consume/` - they'll be automatically imported.

**Export all documents:**
```
cd /config && docker compose exec paperless document_exporter ../export/
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=documents` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["documents", "paperless", "pdf", "ocr"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Paperless-ngx route (internal only)
module "paperless_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "docs"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "docs.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "docs.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - Authelia protected
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# Stirling-PDF route (internal only)
module "stirling_pdf_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "pdf"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "pdf.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - Authelia protected
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authelia"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.documents.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.documents.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.documents.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    direct_paperless      = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"
    paperless_internal    = module.paperless_route.internal_url
    paperless_public      = module.paperless_route.public_url

    direct_stirling_pdf   = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"
    stirling_pdf_internal = module.stirling_pdf_route.internal_url
    stirling_pdf_public   = module.stirling_pdf_route.public_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    paperless    = module.paperless_route.remote_config_path
    stirling_pdf = module.stirling_pdf_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

---
# =============================================================================
# Configure PBS Backup Client in LXC Container
# =============================================================================
# This playbook is generated by the lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module.
# It configures proxmox-backup-client for zero-downtime incremental backups.
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure PBS backup for ${container_name}
  hosts: ${container_name}
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    container_id: ${container_id}
    namespace: ${namespace}
    schedule: ${schedule}
    retention: ${retention}
    pbs_server: ${pbs_server}
    pbs_datastore: ${pbs_datastore}
    pbs_user: ${pbs_user}
    pbs_password_cmd: ${pbs_password_cmd}
    pbs_repository: ${pbs_user}@${pbs_server}:${pbs_datastore}

    backup_script_dir: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup
    backup_script_path: /usr/local/bin/pbs-backup/backup-${container_id}.sh
    log_dir: /var/log/pbs-backups
    log_file: /var/log/pbs-backups/${namespace}.log

    systemd_service_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.service
    systemd_timer_name: pbs-backup-${container_id}.timer

    ntfy_url: ${ntfy_url}
    ntfy_priority: ${ntfy_priority}
    ntfy_tags: ${ntfy_tags}

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Install proxmox-backup-client
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if proxmox-backup-client is already installed
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: which proxmox-backup-client
      register: pbs_client_check
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Install proxmox-backup-client dependencies
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - curl
          - ca-certificates
        state: present
        update_cache: true
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Download proxmox-backup-client binary
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: https://cloud-pbs.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/proxmox-backup-client
        dest: /usr/local/bin/proxmox-backup-client
        mode: '0755'
        checksum: sha256:85b477e2f17b86947f332cfe71ccfc365e1c9821a7a748899b13fcffbcd0c8f9
      when: pbs_client_check.rc != 0

    - name: Verify proxmox-backup-client installation
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: proxmox-backup-client version
      register: pbs_version_check
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display proxmox-backup-client version
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ pbs_version_check.stdout }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure PBS Password
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create PBS encryption key directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /root/.config/proxmox-backup
        state: directory
        mode: '0700'

    - name: Get PBS certificate fingerprint
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          ssh root@{{ pbs_server }} "proxmox-backup-manager cert info" | \
          grep "Fingerprint (sha256):" | \
          awk '{print $NF}'
      register: pbs_fingerprint
      changed_when: false
      delegate_to: localhost

    - name: Get PBS password from 1Password
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: {{ pbs_password_cmd }}
      register: pbs_password
      changed_when: false
      delegate_to: localhost
      no_log: true

    - name: Store PBS password and fingerprint in environment file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          PBS_REPOSITORY={{ pbs_repository }}
          PBS_NAMESPACE={{ namespace }}
          PBS_PASSWORD={{ pbs_password.stdout }}
          PBS_FINGERPRINT={{ pbs_fingerprint.stdout }}
        dest: /root/.pbs-backup-env
        mode: '0600'
      no_log: true

    # =========================================================================
    # Create PBS Namespace (if specified and doesn't exist)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create PBS namespace
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          set -a
          source /root/.pbs-backup-env
          set +a
          proxmox-backup-client namespace create {{ namespace }} --repository {{ pbs_repository }}
        executable: /bin/bash
      register: namespace_create
      changed_when: "'created namespace' in namespace_create.stdout or namespace_create.rc == 0"
      failed_when: false
      no_log: true
      when: namespace != ""

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Backup Script
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create backup script directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ backup_script_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Create log directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ log_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Deploy backup script
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          ${indent(10, backup_script)}
        dest: "{{ backup_script_path }}"
        mode: '0755'

    # =========================================================================
    # Create Systemd Service & Timer
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create systemd service
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=PBS Backup for ${container_name} (${namespace})
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=oneshot
          EnvironmentFile=/root/.pbs-backup-env
          ExecStart={{ backup_script_path }}
          StandardOutput=append:{{ log_file }}
          StandardError=append:{{ log_file }}

          # Resource limits
          CPUQuota=50%
          MemoryMax=1G

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_service_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: service_file

    - name: Determine systemd timer schedule
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        timer_oncalendar: |-
          {%- if schedule == "daily" -%}
          daily
          {%- elif schedule | regex_search('^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$') -%}
          *-*-* {{ schedule }}
          {%- else -%}
          {{ schedule }}
          {%- endif -%}

    - name: Create systemd timer
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Timer for PBS Backup of ${container_name}

          [Timer]
          OnCalendar={{ timer_oncalendar }}
          Persistent=true
          RandomizedDelaySec=5min

          [Install]
          WantedBy=timers.target
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ systemd_timer_name }}
        mode: '0644'
      register: timer_file

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true
      when: service_file is changed or timer_file is changed

    - name: Enable and start timer
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ systemd_timer_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check timer status
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: systemctl status {{ systemd_timer_name }}
      register: timer_status
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Display configuration summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Backup Configured for ${container_name} ==="
          - ""
          - "Container ID: ${container_id}"
          - "Namespace: ${namespace}"
          - "Schedule: {{ timer_oncalendar }}"
          - "Repository: {{ pbs_repository }}"
          - "Log file: {{ log_file }}"
          - ""
          - "Manual trigger:"
          - "  systemctl start {{ systemd_service_name }}"
          - ""
          - "Check timer:"
          - "  systemctl list-timers {{ systemd_timer_name }}"
          - ""
          - "View logs:"
          - "  tail -f {{ log_file }}"

name: documents

  # ==========================================================================

  paperless:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:2.20.2

      - PAPERLESS_DBHOST=paperless-db
      - PAPERLESS_DBNAME=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBUSER=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBPASS=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY}
      - PAPERLESS_URL=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev

      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_TIME_ZONE=America/New_York
      - PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE=eng
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_POLLING=60
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_RECURSIVE=true
      - PAPERLESS_TASK_WORKERS=2
      - PAPERLESS_THREADS_PER_WORKER=2
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - paperless-data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - paperless-media:/usr/src/paperless/media
      - ./consume:/usr/src/paperless/consume
      - ./export:/usr/src/paperless/export
    depends_on:
      paperless-db:
        condition: service_healthy
      paperless-redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8000/api/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # PostgreSQL - Database for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: paperless-db
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=paperless
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=paperless
    volumes:
      - paperless-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U paperless"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Redis - Cache/Broker for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-redis:
    image: redis:8.4-alpine
    container_name: paperless-redis
    volumes:
      - paperless-redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Stirling-PDF - PDF Manipulation Tools
  # ==========================================================================
  # Comprehensive PDF toolkit: merge, split, compress, OCR, convert, etc.
  # Stateless service - no persistent data needed.
  stirling-pdf:
    image: stirlingtools/stirling-pdf:2.1.4
    container_name: stirling-pdf

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.documents.container_id
  container_ip   = module.documents.ip_address
  container_name = "documents"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "lxc-504"

    pre_backup_commands = [{
      name    = "PostgreSQL dump (Paperless)"
      command = "docker exec paperless-db pg_dump -U paperless -d paperless --clean --if-exists | gzip > /config/paperless-db-backup.sql.gz"
      timeout = 300
    }]

    include_paths = ["/config", "/var/lib/docker/volumes"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,documents,paperless"
  }

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# =============================================================================
# Documents LXC - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 504
# IP: 10.100.5.104
#
# Document management stack:
# - Paperless-ngx: OCR, full-text search, auto-tagging, email consumption
# - Stirling-PDF: PDF manipulation (merge, split, compress, convert, etc.)
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Paperless Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "paperless" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "paperless"
}

locals {
  # Flatten paperless section fields into a map by label
  _paperless_section_fields = merge([
    for s in try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.section, []) : {
      for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  paperless = {
    admin_user     = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.username, "admin")
    admin_password = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.password, "")
    db_password    = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "db_password", "")
    secret_key     = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "secret_key", "")
  }
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "documents_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Documents Stack Environment
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Paperless-ngx
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${local.paperless.admin_user}
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.admin_password}
PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.db_password}
PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${local.paperless.secret_key}

# Portainer Edge Agent
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${local.portainer_edge["documents"].edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 504
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4  # OCR is CPU intensive
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192  # OCR needs memory
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64  # Documents can grow large
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documents Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "documents"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # NOTE: Do NOT pass portainer_edge_id/key here - we handle the combined .env file
  # ourselves (including both paperless secrets AND portainer credentials).
  # The module's portainer env feature only supports portainer-only env files.

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure .env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.documents_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Documents"
  service_description = "Document management with Paperless-ngx (OCR) and Stirling-PDF (utilities)"

  service_urls = {

    stirling_pdf_internal = "https://pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
    stirling_pdf_public   = "https://pdf.${var.domain_public}"

                - name: Deploy backup script

                    content: |
                      #!/bin/bash
                      # =============================================================================
                      # PBS Backup Script for documents (Container 504)
                      # =============================================================================
                      # Generated by lxc-sidecars OpenTofu module
                      # Namespace: lxc-504
                      # Schedule: daily
                      # Retention: 7 backups
                      # =============================================================================
                      
                      set -euo pipefail
                      
                      # =============================================================================
                      # Configuration
                      # =============================================================================
                      
                      CONTAINER_ID="504"
                      NAMESPACE="lxc-504"
                      RETENTION="7"
                      LOG_FILE="/var/log/pbs-backups/${NAMESPACE}.log"
                      
                      # PBS repository from environment (set by systemd service)
                      # PBS_REPOSITORY, PBS_NAMESPACE, PBS_PASSWORD, PBS_FINGERPRINT
                      
                      # Backup paths
                      INCLUDE_PATHS=(
                        "/config"
                        "/var/lib/docker/volumes"
                      )
                      
                      EXCLUDE_PATTERNS=(
                        "/var/lib/docker/overlay2"
                      )
                      
                      # Alert configuration
                      NTFY_URL="http://10.100.5.100:8080/homelab-alerts"
                      NTFY_PRIORITY="default"
                      NTFY_TAGS="backup,documents,paperless"
                      
                      # =============================================================================
                      # Helper Functions
                      # =============================================================================
                      
                      log() {
                          echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*"
                      }
                      
                      send_alert() {
                          local title="$1"
                          local message="$2"
                          local priority="${3:-${NTFY_PRIORITY}}"
                      
                          curl -sf \
                              -H "Title: ${title}" \
                              -H "Priority: ${priority}" \
                              -H "Tags: ${NTFY_TAGS}" \
                              -d "${message}" \
                              "${NTFY_URL}" 2>/dev/null || true
                      }
                      
                      # =============================================================================
                      # Pre-Backup Commands (Database Dumps, etc.)
                      # =============================================================================
                      
                      run_pre_backup_hooks() {
                          log "Running pre-backup hooks..."
                      
                          # PostgreSQL dump (Paperless)
                          log "  - PostgreSQL dump (Paperless)"
                          if timeout 300 bash -c 'docker exec paperless-db pg_dump -U paperless -d paperless --clean --if-exists | gzip > /config/paperless-db-backup.sql.gz'; then
                              log "    ✓ Success"
                          else
                              log "    ✗ Failed (exit code: $$?)"
                              send_alert "Backup Hook Failed: documents" \
                                  "Pre-backup hook failed: PostgreSQL dump (Paperless)" \
                                  "high"
                              return 1
                          fi
                      
                      }
                      
                      # =============================================================================
                      # Cleanup Functions
                      # =============================================================================
                      
                      cleanup_temp_files() {
                          log "Cleaning up temporary dump files..."
                      
                          # Remove database dumps after successful backup

                      # Main Backup Function
                      # =============================================================================
                      
                      run_backup() {
                          local backup_id="lxc-${CONTAINER_ID}"
                          local backup_time=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
                          local start_time=$(date +%s)
                      
                          log "=== Starting PBS Backup for documents ==="
                          log "Repository: ${PBS_REPOSITORY}"
                          log "Namespace: ${PBS_NAMESPACE}"
                          log "Backup ID: ${backup_id}"
                          log "Backup time: ${backup_time}"
                      
                          # Build exclude arguments
                          local exclude_args=""
                          for pattern in "${EXCLUDE_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
                              exclude_args="${exclude_args} --exclude '${pattern}'"
                          done
                      
                          # Build backup command
                          local backup_cmd="proxmox-backup-client backup"
                      
                          for path in "${INCLUDE_PATHS[@]}"; do
                              local archive_name=$(basename "${path}")
                              backup_cmd="${backup_cmd} '${archive_name}.pxar:${path}'"
                          done
                      
                          backup_cmd="${backup_cmd} --repository \$PBS_REPOSITORY"
                          backup_cmd="${backup_cmd} --ns \$PBS_NAMESPACE"
                          backup_cmd="${backup_cmd} --backup-id '${backup_id}'"
                          backup_cmd="${backup_cmd} --backup-time $(date +%s)"
                      
                          if [ -n "${exclude_args}" ]; then
                              backup_cmd="${backup_cmd} ${exclude_args}"
                          fi
                      
                          # Set PBS fingerprint environment variable for certificate verification
                          export PBS_FINGERPRINT
                      
                          log "Command: ${backup_cmd}"
                      
                          # Run backup
                          if eval "${backup_cmd}"; then
                              local end_time=$(date +%s)
                              local duration=$((end_time - start_time))
                      
                              log "✓ Backup completed successfully in ${duration}s"
                      
                              # Prune old backups
                              log "Pruning old backups (keep ${RETENTION})..."
                              proxmox-backup-client prune "host/${backup_id}" \
                                  --repository "$PBS_REPOSITORY" \
                                  --ns "$PBS_NAMESPACE" \
                                  --keep-last "${RETENTION}"
                      
                              log "✓ Prune completed"
                      
                              # Cleanup temporary files
                              cleanup_temp_files
                      
                              log "=== Backup Completed Successfully ==="
                              return 0
                          else
                              local exit_code=$$?
                              log "✗ Backup failed with exit code: ${exit_code}"
                      
                              send_alert "Backup Failed: documents" \
                                  "PBS backup failed for lxc-504 (exit code: ${exit_code})" \
                                  "high"
                      
                              return 1
                          fi
                      }
                      
                      # =============================================================================
                      # Main Execution
                      # =============================================================================
                      
                      main() {
                          log "========================================"
                          log "PBS Backup: documents"
                          log "Container ID: 504"
                          log "Namespace: lxc-504"
                          log "========================================"
                      
                          # Run pre-backup hooks
                          if ! run_pre_backup_hooks; then
                              log "Pre-backup hooks failed, aborting backup"
                              exit 1
                          fi
                      
                          # Run backup
                          if ! run_backup; then
                              log "Backup failed"
                              exit 1
                          fi
                      
                          log "All tasks completed successfully"
                          exit 0
                      }
                      
                      # Run main function
                      main

                      [Unit]
                      Description=PBS Backup for documents (lxc-504)

run_backup() {

    # Build backup command

    for path in "${INCLUDE_PATHS[@]}"; do
        local archive_name=$(basename "${path}")
        backup_cmd="${backup_cmd} '${archive_name}.pxar:${path}'"

    backup_cmd="${backup_cmd} --ns \$PBS_NAMESPACE"
    backup_cmd="${backup_cmd} --backup-id '${backup_id}'"
    backup_cmd="${backup_cmd} --backup-time $(date +%s)"

}

# =============================================================================
# Jellyfin LXC - Media Server
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 401
# IP: 192.168.1.226

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate combined .env file with Jellystat + Edge credentials
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE: We generate a combined .env file here instead of using the docker-lxc
# module's portainer_edge_id/key because Jellyfin needs additional env vars
# for Jellystat (DB password, JWT secret). The module would overwrite these.

resource "local_sensitive_file" "jellyfin_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Jellyfin Stack Environment Variables
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Jellystat PostgreSQL credentials
JELLYSTAT_DB_PASSWORD=st4dnS0X75gJTlATNXYBWQawJ4OzYQ
JELLYSTAT_JWT_SECRET=69z87jUXLPJxIkao3EGXW8QF51ZTM5uSSucwJaw6I

# Portainer Edge Agent credentials (from 1Password: portainer-edge-jellyfin)
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${local.portainer_edge["jellyfin"].edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${local.portainer_edge["jellyfin"].edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

module "jellyfin" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "jellyfin"
  container_id = 401
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for DLNA/casting)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.jellyfin}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  cores  = 4
  memory = 8192
  swap   = 2048

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = 32

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Enable AMD GPU passthrough for hardware transcoding
  enable_gpu = true

  # NOTE: We don't set portainer_edge_id/key here because this app generates
  # its own .env file that includes both Jellystat and Edge credentials.
  # Setting them here would cause the docker-lxc module to create a separate
  # .env that would overwrite our combined one.

  # Mount point for media library
  # This is configured via SSH (null_resource.configure_mount_points) since
  # the API token doesn't have permission for bind mounts (requires root@pam)
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/data/library"
      volume = "/tank/data/library"
    }
  ]

  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  service_name        = "Jellyfin"
  service_description = "Media server for movies, TV shows, and music"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://jellyfin.${var.domain_internal}"
    public   = "https://jellyfin.${var.domain_public}"
    direct   = "http://192.168.1.226:8096"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Jellyfin", port = 8096, info = "Media server UI" },
    { name = "Jellyseerr", port = 5055, info = "Media request management" },
    { name = "Jellystat", port = 3000, info = "Statistics dashboard" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands
**View logs:** cd /config && docker compose logs -f jellyfin
**Restart:** cd /config && docker compose restart jellyfin
EOT

  tags = ["jellyfin", "media"]
}

module "jellyfin_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "jellyfin"
  backend_url = "http://${module.jellyfin.ip_address}:8096"

  internal_domain = "jellyfin.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "jellyfin.${var.domain_public}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.jellyfin]
}

# Jellystat - Jellyfin statistics dashboard
module "jellystat_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "jellystat"
  backend_url = "http://${module.jellyfin.ip_address}:3000"

  internal_domain = "jellystat.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Has built-in auth, only need security headers and internal access
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "internal-only"]

  depends_on = [module.jellyfin]
}

# Jellyseerr/Requests - Media request management
module "requests_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "requests"
  backend_url = "http://${module.jellyfin.ip_address}:5055"

  internal_domain = "requests.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "requests.${var.domain_public}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["public-security"]

  depends_on = [module.jellyfin]
}

output "container_id" { value = module.jellyfin.container_id }
output "ip_address" { value = module.jellyfin.ip_address }
output "ssh_command" { value = module.jellyfin.ssh_command }
output "urls" {
  value = {
    jellyfin  = { internal = module.jellyfin_route.internal_url, public = module.jellyfin_route.public_url }
    jellystat = { internal = module.jellystat_route.internal_url }
    requests  = { internal = module.requests_route.internal_url, public = module.requests_route.public_url }
  }
}

# Jellyfin Media Server Stack
# Includes: Jellyfin, Jellyseerr, Jellystat + PostgreSQL

name: jellyfin

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyfin - Media Streaming Server
  # ==========================================================================
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:10.11.5
    container_name: jellyfin
    user: 1000:1000
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    ports:
      - "8096:8096"
    volumes:
      - jellyfin-config:/config
      - jellyfin-cache:/cache
      - /data/library:/data/library:ro
    # AMD GPU passthrough for hardware transcoding (VA-API)
    group_add:
      - "44"   # video group for GPU access
      - "104"  # render group for GPU access
    devices:
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
      - /dev/kfd:/dev/kfd
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyseerr - Media Request Management (Overseerr fork for Jellyfin)
  # ==========================================================================
  jellyseerr:
    image: fallenbagel/jellyseerr:2.7.3
    container_name: jellyseerr
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
    ports:
      - "5055:5055"
    volumes:
      - jellyseerr-config:/app/config
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellystat - Statistics and Analytics for Jellyfin
  # ==========================================================================
  jellystat:
    image: cyfershepard/jellystat:1.1.6
    container_name: jellystat
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - POSTGRES_USER=jellystat
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${JELLYSTAT_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_IP=jellystat-db
      - POSTGRES_PORT=5432
      - JWT_SECRET=${JELLYSTAT_JWT_SECRET}
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - jellystat-data:/app/backend/backup-data
    depends_on:
      jellystat-db:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # PostgreSQL - Database for Jellystat
  # ==========================================================================
  jellystat-db:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: jellystat-db
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=jellystat
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${JELLYSTAT_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=jellystat
    volumes:
      - jellystat-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U jellystat"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-jellyfin
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.6
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  jellyfin-config:
  jellyfin-cache:
  jellyseerr-config:
  jellystat-data:
  jellystat-pgdata:
  portainer_agent_data:

# NOTE: We generate a combined .env file here instead of using the docker-lxc
# module's portainer_edge_id/key because Jellyfin needs additional env vars

resource "local_sensitive_file" "jellyfin_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Jellyfin Stack Environment Variables
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password

PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${local.portainer_edge["jellyfin"].edge_key}

  file_permission = "0600"

module "jellyfin" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "jellyfin"
  container_id = 401
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for DLNA/casting)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.jellyfin}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  cores  = 4
  memory = 8192
  swap   = 2048

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = 32

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Enable AMD GPU passthrough for hardware transcoding
  enable_gpu = true

  # NOTE: We don't set portainer_edge_id/key here because this app generates
  # its own .env file that includes both Jellystat and Edge credentials.
  # Setting them here would cause the docker-lxc module to create a separate
  # .env that would overwrite our combined one.

  # Mount point for media library
  # This is configured via SSH (null_resource.configure_mount_points) since
  # the API token doesn't have permission for bind mounts (requires root@pam)
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/data/library"
      volume = "/tank/data/library"
    }
  ]

  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  service_name        = "Jellyfin"
  service_description = "Media server for movies, TV shows, and music"

  service_urls = {
